title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 16, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of April 13–19, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of April 13–19, 2026.

TOKENIZATION

JPMorgan Brings Deposit Token to Canton Network, Marking New Era for Institutional Finance: JPMorgan Chase has announced plans to deploy its JPM deposit token on the Canton Network through its tokenization platform, Kinexys — a move that positions Canton as a cornerstone infrastructure for next-generation institutional finance. Read more.

HSBC Completes First Tokenised Deposit Pilot on Canton Network: HSBC has successfully completed a pilot simulating the issuance, transfer, and atomic settlement of its Tokenised Deposit Service (TDS) on the Canton Network — marking the first time the bank's TDS was issued and used on a public blockchain. Read more.

Stablecoins Set to Move $719 Trillion Through Global Payments — and Canton Network Is Already at the Center: Visa, Mastercard, and Stripe are moving deeper into stablecoin settlement infrastructure. Canton Network is emerging as one institutional layer for payments, settlement, and treasury use cases. Read more.

ANALYSIS

Canton Network vs. Ethereum: Institutional Blockchain Reality or TradFi Detour?: Canton’s growth in institutional settlement raises a bigger question for blockchain adoption: will financial markets favor open rails like Ethereum, or privacy-first networks like Canton? Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

ClearToken Appoints Chief Risk Officer as Canton-Based Platforms Advance Toward Launch: ClearToken has named Fernando Cerezetti as Chief Risk Officer of its CCP subsidiary — a high-profile appointment that signals the firm's accelerating push to deliver the first FMI-grade infrastructure for tokenized settlement on the Canton Network. Read more.

Canton Network Executes World's First Private Stablecoin Payroll for a Global Enterprise: Canton Network powered a private stablecoin payroll for a global enterprise. The milestone shows how institutional blockchain infrastructure can support real business payments. Read more.

Visa Expands Blockchain Infrastructure Footprint — With Canton Network Super Validator Role at the Core: Visa’s new blockchain validator work adds to its broader institutional infrastructure strategy. Its Canton Network Super Validator commitment remains part of that footprint. Read more.

Canton Network Emerges as Focal Point at Paris Blockchain Week 2026: Paris Blockchain Week highlighted privacy and composability as key barriers to institutional blockchain adoption. Canton Network was positioned as one of the projects addressing both. Read more.

Northern Trust Integrates with Canton Network to Build Institutional Custody for Tokenized Assets: Northern Trust is working with Digital Asset to develop custody capabilities for tokenized financial assets on Canton Network. The move extends its asset servicing model into digital market infrastructure. Read more.

MARKETS

CC Holds Steady at $0.139–$0.147 as Institutional Momentum Builds: CC has held a tight $0.139-$0.147 range as institutional momentum builds around Canton. The market is weighing a different kind of blockchain asset with an institution-first design. Read more.

Upbit Announces Canton (CC) Listing on KRW, BTC, and USDT Markets: South Korea's largest crypto exchange, Upbit, has announced the listing of Canton (CC) across its KRW, BTC, and USDT markets — a significant milestone for CC's accessibility in one of the world's most active crypto trading regions. Read more.

CC Consolidates Near $0.147 as Institutional Momentum Builds Beneath the Surface: CC is holding near $0.147 while Canton’s institutional milestones continue to build. Recent HSBC, JPMorgan, and CredShields activity points to growing long-term network momentum. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Inside Canton Network: The Infrastructure Layer Powering Institutional Finance: Canton Network is already being used across institutional finance, from tokenized settlement to major partnerships. This overview explains how the network works and who is building on it. Read more.

CredShields Joins Canton Network as Official Audit Partner: CredShields has joined Canton Network as an official Audit Partner. The move brings smart-contract security expertise to infrastructure used by institutional finance. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 17, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of April 20–26, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of April 20–26, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

Hanwha Investment & Securities Signs MOU with Blockchain Firm Digital Asset: Hanwha Investment & Securities has signed an MOU with Digital Asset, the company behind Canton Network, to explore cooperation across different areas of finance. Read more.

Mizuho, Nomura, JSCC and Digital Asset Bring JGB Collateral Pilot to Canton Network: A new pilot on Canton Network will test how Japanese government bonds can support real-time, 24/7 collateral management across domestic and cross-border markets. Read more.

HQLAᵡ Announces Strategic Investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset to Support Next Growth Phase on Canton: HQLAᵡ has secured strategic investments from Broadridge and Digital Asset to support its next phase of growth on Canton. Read more.

ANALYSIS

Canton Strategic Holdings Publishes First Quarterly Canton Network Ecosystem Update: Canton Strategic Holdings has published its Q1 2026 ecosystem report on Canton Network, outlining adoption milestones, transaction growth, and key infrastructure developments across the quarter. Read more.

MARKETS

Canton (CC) Listed on LBank — CC/USDT Trading Goes Live April 22: LBank, a leading global cryptocurrency exchange, has announced the listing of Canton (CC) on its platform, with CC/USDT spot trading scheduled to open on April 22, 2026 — further expanding CC's accessibility across global markets. Read more.

HTX Opens $CC Spot Trading on April 22: HTX has announced the launch of $CC spot trading on its platform, with the CC/USDT pair scheduled to go live at 10:00 UTC on April 22, 2026, expanding market access for Canton’s native asset. Read more.

Bitget to List Canton Coin (CC) on April 24 With 2.79 Million CC in Rewards: Bitget will list Canton (CC) on April 24, with Launchpool and CandyBomb campaigns offering users a combined 2.79 million CC in rewards. Read more.

Canton Goes Live on SwissBorg, Expanding Fiat Access for $CC: SwissBorg now supports Canton, allowing users to buy $CC with 11 fiat currencies through card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

WalletConnect Adds Support for Canton Network: WalletConnect has added support for Canton Network, enabling access to institutional-grade apps and tokenized real-world assets through its wallet connectivity network. Read more.

Temple Lightspeed: A New Era For Trading On Canton: Temple has introduced Lightspeed, a major upgrade to its trading infrastructure on Canton, capable of processing over 100,000 orders per second with sub-10ms matching. Read more.

Bitwave Enables Invoice-Linked, On-Chain Payments via Canton Integration: Bitwave has integrated with Canton Network to connect invoices, payments, and settlement into programmable on-chain workflows for enterprise finance teams. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Cancore Genesis Phase 2 Goes Live on Canton: Cancore Genesis Phase 2 is now live, bringing $CC and $CBTC trading, transfer history, network fees, and improved infrastructure. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 18, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of April 27–03, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of April 27 – May 03, 2026.

MARKETS

Canton Tops Chain Revenue Rankings, Ahead of Tron and Ethereum: DefiLlama data showed Canton in first place on chain revenue, with Tron second and Ethereum third in the latest 24-hour rankings. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Tokenized Treasurys Top $10.8B as Institutional Interest Grows: Tokenized Treasurys are on-chain representations of U.S. government debt instruments, classified as real-world assets, or RWAs. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Visa Adds Canton Network to Stablecoin Settlement Pilot as Run Rate Hits $7B: Visa added Canton Network to its global stablecoin settlement pilot as the program expanded to nine blockchains and reached a $7B annualized settlement run rate, up 50% from the previous quarter. Read more.

Tradeweb Cites Canton Network Validation Services as Q1 Digital-Asset Revenue Driver: Tradeweb reported $617.8M in Q1 revenue, said Other revenue rose 56.2% year over year, and later disclosed $3.7M of Validator Revenue tied to Canton Network services in its SEC filing. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Canton Protocol 3.5 Introduces Logical Synchronizers for No-Downtime Upgrades: Canton is moving from Protocol 3.4 to 3.5, with Logical Synchronizers designed to let the network upgrade without pausing transaction processing. Read more.

REGULATION

Global Settlement Network Brings GSX ID Compliance Layer to Canton as Validator: Global Settlement Network has been approved as a Canton validator and Featured Application, deploying GSX ID to help institutions reuse compliance credentials across tokenized capital market workflows. Read more.

ANALYSIS

Grayscale Says Canton Could Lead Early Institutional Phase of Tokenization: Grayscale Research names Canton alongside Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche, BNB Chain and Chainlink as networks positioned to benefit from the shift of capital markets onchain. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

A Look Inside the Applications Building on Canton Network: Canton Network is best known for institutional finance, but a growing app layer is forming around Canton Coin, spanning wallets, explorers, DeFi apps, payment tools, NFT products, analytics platforms and trading venues. Read more.

Chainlink Integrates With Alpend and Raven Market as Canton’s Application Layer Takes Shape: Alpend and Raven Market are adopting Chainlink Data Streams to support private credit markets and deterministic options settlement on Canton. Read more.

Lattice Brings Canton’s First Neobank and Privacy-Focused Banking Rails Closer to Launch: Lattice is preparing to launch a Canton-based neobank that combines private settlement, self-custody, card spending and always-on access to digital assets. Read more.

OneSwap Publishes Mainnet Review Showing Full Reserve Alignment: OneSwap says its active mainnet pools were fully aligned with the live ledger during a new operational review prepared for liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 19, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of May 04–10, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of May 04–10, 2026.

TECHNOLOGY

Canton Ends Passive Validator Rewards as Incentives Shift Toward Usage: Canton Network has ended liveness rewards for validators, moving its incentive model away from passive node operation and toward usage, application demand, and long-term alignment. Read more.

ANALYSIS

DeFi’s Security Reckoning Makes Canton Network’s Guardrails Harder to Dismiss: Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz says institutions need ways to keep bad actors away from the assets and systems they operate on-chain. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Northern Trust and LSEG Among 22 Applicants to Operate Canton Validators: Canton Network’s latest validator operator batch includes Northern Trust, LSEG and a wider set of infrastructure and application-focused firms. The list shows validator interest extending from major financial institutions to smaller operators ahead of a May 6 approval deadline. Read more.

Kresus and Canton Network Move to Bridge the Institutional Blockchain Execution Gap: Kresus and Canton Network have partnered to help financial institutions take blockchain projects from development into live deployment — starting with a tokenized asset platform for South Korea's Hanwha Investment & Securities. Read more.

AMINA Becomes First Bank to Support Canton Coin Trading and Custody: AMINA Bank has become the first regulated banking institution to offer custody and trading for Canton Coin, giving institutional clients and network participants a supervised entry point into Canton Network's growing capital markets infrastructure. Read more.

Canton Foundation’s Viv Diwakar Joins Bitcoin Seoul 2026 Speaker Lineup: Canton Foundation Head Viv Diwakar is listed among the speakers for Bitcoin Seoul 2026, which will take place June 4–5 at FKI Tower in Seoul. The event’s agenda is expected to focus on on-chain finance, real-world assets, stablecoins and AI, giving Canton a relevant stage in one of Asia’s major blockchain gatherings. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

DTCC Sets July Target for Initial Tokenized Securities Trades: DTCC plans to facilitate initial, limited production trades through DTC’s tokenization service in July 2026, with a broader launch planned for October. Digital Asset, identified by DTCC as creator of Canton Network, is among more than 50 firms in the industry working group. The update follows DTCC’s separate partnership with Digital Asset and Canton Network to tokenize a subset of DTC-custodied U.S. Treasuries on Canton. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

CIP-0105 Sets Locking Framework for Canton Super Validators: CIP-0105 introduces a voluntary locking framework for Canton Super Validators. The approved proposal links forward SV Weight to actively locked lifetime-earned Canton Coin rewards and sets rules for tiered weighting, unlock vesting, custody and enforcement. Read more.

Why Now Is the Time to Build on Canton Network: Canton is moving away from passive validator rewards and toward application activity, shared tooling, and ecosystem development. For eligible Featured Apps, rewards are now tied more directly to usage, while grants remain selective. The direction is clear: Canton’s next phase depends on builders turning its infrastructure into useful financial applications. Read more.

Temple Listed on CoinMarketCap as Top Global Exchange for $CC: Temple is now listed on CoinMarketCap, giving the Canton-native trading platform a clearer public market-data profile. The listing makes Temple easier for traders to find, compare and track, while showing the platform as the top global exchange for $CC by 24-hour notional volume during the cited window. Read more.

Canton Network Welcomes 33 New Validator Operators to Its Growing Infrastructure: Canton Network has welcomed 33 new validator operators, broadening the infrastructure base that supports the network's security and institutional-grade operations. Read more.

MARKETS

21Shares Launches First U.S. ETF Offering Exposure to Canton Coin on Nasdaq: 21Shares has listed what it calls the first U.S. ETF offering exposure to Canton Coin on Nasdaq, with Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, and Deutsche Bank among the institutions participating in the network — though not endorsing the fund. Read more.

Kaiko Indices Named Benchmark Provider for 21Shares Canton ETF: Kaiko Indices will provide the benchmark behind TCAN, the 21Shares Canton Network ETF listed on Nasdaq. The role adds an independent reference-rate layer to the fund and extends Kaiko’s existing work around $CC market data. Read more.

ACME Brings Lending to Canton as the Network Moves Beyond Settlement: ACME Lend is bringing lending and borrowing markets to Canton Network, testing whether the network’s privacy-focused infrastructure can support a deeper onchain credit layer. The launch adds another core financial primitive to a network that is still building out its application depth. Read more.

Digital Asset Targets $2 Billion Valuation as a16z Crypto Moves to Lead $300 Million Round: Digital Asset is seeking roughly $300 million in new funding at a $2 billion valuation, with a16z crypto expected to lead, as institutional demand for regulated blockchain infrastructure continues to draw significant capital. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 20, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of May 11–17, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of May 11–17, 2026.

ECOSYSTEM

Privket Launches Canton Network's First NFT Collection: Privket’s Canton Penguin collection sold out on Canton Network, marking the chain’s first NFT drop and an early test of collectible activity on the network. Read more.

Cantor8 Plans Canton-Powered Mobile Money Pilot in Africa With Yiksi Limited: Cantor8 has secured exclusive MOUs with Yiksi Limited to explore bringing M-PESA and EVC Plus onto blockchain rails through Canton Network. Read more.

Rho Labs Announces Rho Relay, Bringing Private Cross-Chain Settlement to the Canton Network: Rho Labs has launched Rho Relay, giving EVM users a private, non-custodial route to access and trade Canton Coin through Canton-native cross-chain settlement. Read more.

Temple Crosses $100 Million in Trading Volume on Canton Network: Temple, the first native trading platform built on Canton Network, has surpassed $100 million in cumulative trading volume, marking a significant milestone for institutional on-chain trading within the Canton ecosystem. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

T-RIZE Launches $50M Private Credit Programme on Canton Network: T-RIZE Group has announced the Kairos Digital Loan Notes programme, opening with a $50 million tranche for eligible institutional and qualified investors. Built on Canton Network, the programme brings UK litigation-finance receivables into a governed digital issuance framework with controls for eligibility, transfers, compliance and lifecycle administration. Read more.

BlockBooster Joins Canton Foundation With Focus on Tokenized Credit: BlockBooster has joined the Canton Foundation, where it plans to contribute to governance, committee work, and ecosystem development focused on tokenized credit, fund tokenization, and real-world asset management standards. Read more.

Societe Generale to Scale Tokenized Finance on Canton: Societe Generale is expanding its work on Canton Network, with plans for tokenized collateral, on-chain financing, repo activity, and the deployment of SG-FORGE’s USD and EUR CoinVertible stablecoins. Read more.

Canton Strategic Deepens Canton Network Bet After First-Quarter Buildout: Canton Strategic ended the first quarter with 3.68 billion Canton Coin, $41.5 million in cash, Super Validator approval, and a strengthened capital base as it builds its public-market strategy around Canton Network infrastructure. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Zenith surpasses 500,000+ EVM transactions in internal test environment: Zenith’s internal test environment has processed more than 500,000 EVM transactions through Canton Network, with a 100% success rate and 1.5-second average latency on an unoptimized stack. The update gives an early look at Zenith’s native EVM architecture for Canton ahead of public testnet access. Read more.

IntellectEU Launches Canton Onboarding Package for DTCC Tokenization Participants: IntellectEU has launched a Canton onboarding package for institutions in the DTCC Industry Working Group, covering node operations, wallet and custody integration, custom development, tokenomics advisory, and legacy system integration. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 21, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of May 18–24, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of May 18–24, 2026.

ANALYSIS

Canton Network Named to BeInCrypto Institutional 100 Blockchain Infrastructure Long List: BeInCrypto included Canton Network among 15 blockchain infrastructure firms selected for its 2026 Institutional 100 “Best Blockchain Infrastructure” long list. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Alpend Launches ONE, a Programmable Dollar Asset for Canton DeFi: Alpend has introduced ONE, a CC-backed debt instrument designed to bring dollar-targeted liquidity to Canton DeFi and expand the utility of Canton Coin as productive collateral. Read more.

SBI Group Leads Strategic Investment in Temple Digital Group: SBI Group has led a private funding round in Temple Digital Group, the top-ranked application on the Canton Network by revenue, as Temple prepares to list regulated markets and expand its institutional trading infrastructure in the second half of 2026. Read more.

Cancore Goes Live, Opening Atomic Swaps Between Canton and Public Chains: Cancore is now live for everyone, giving users a non-custodial way to swap assets between Canton Network and public blockchains through peer-to-peer atomic settlement. Read more.

Canton Network Welcomes 32 New Validator Operators: Canton Network has welcomed 32 new validator operators, including CME Group and Kakao Bank, as the network's infrastructure base continues to grow. Read more.

MARKETS

Bybit Adds USDCx Deposits on Canton Network: Bybit has enabled USDCx deposits via Canton Network, with withdrawal support to follow once liquidity thresholds are reached. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Certora Wins Canton Foundation Grant for Daml Analysis Tooling: Certora has received a Canton Development Fund grant to build open-source tooling that helps developers and institutions analyze cross-package interactions in Daml applications before deployment. Read more.

Canton Network Approves CIP-0116, Introducing CC Locking Requirements for Featured App Status: Canton Network has approved CIP-0116, requiring Featured App applicants to lock between 5 million and 25 million CC per PartyId to qualify for and maintain Featured App designation, replacing a Foundation-led process with on-chain, market-based criteria. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Digital Asset Appoints OCC Strategy Head Oberon Knapp as Global Head of Equities: Digital Asset has named Oberon Knapp, formerly head of strategy at the Options Clearing Corporation, as its global head of equities, tasking him with leading institutional equity and derivatives market structure strategy on Canton Network. Read more.

Grayscale Names Canton Among Blockchains Poised to Benefit From Regulatory Clarity: Grayscale’s latest Stack article puts Canton alongside Ethereum, Solana and BNB Chain as networks positioned to benefit if US digital asset rules become clearer. For Canton, the signal is especially important: its strongest use case is not retail speculation, but regulated tokenization, privacy and institutional onchain finance. Read more.

JPMorgan's Kinexys Crosses $1.5 Trillion in Cumulative Volume: JPMorgan's Kinexys blockchain has crossed $1.5 trillion in cumulative volume, while the bank pursues a tokenized Treasury fund and plans to bring JPM Coin to Canton Network for institutional deposit token settlements in 2026. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 22, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of May 25–31, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of May 25–31, 2026.

ECOSYSTEM

OneSwap Launches as Canton Network's First Permissionless DEX: OneSwap, built by Draper Associates and Coinbase Ventures-backed Sats Terminal, has launched as a permissionless AMM on the Canton Network, opening CC, USDCx, and tokenized Bitcoin trading to retail users on institutional settlement infrastructure. Read more.

Send Opens Base-to-Canton Bridge for SEND, USDC, cbBTC and frxUSD: Selected Base assets can now bridge directly into Send App on Canton, giving users a path to bring SEND, USDC, cbBTC and frxUSD into Send Canton Wallet as wrapped .B assets. Read more.

How $CC Holders Can Put Their Tokens to Work Across DeFi: Canton DeFi is starting to give CC holders more ways to use their capital. From lending and borrowing to staking, liquidity pools, vaults, trading and bridges, there are now several live routes for putting CC and related assets to work. Read more.

Edel Finance Plans Canton-Based Perpetual Futures Exchange: Edel Finance plans to launch Edel Markets in Q3 2026, bringing on-chain perpetual futures for equities and commodities to Canton Network. Read more.

Canborsa Opens Beta for RWA Perpetuals on Canton Network: Canborsa has launched the beta of its Canton Network-based trading platform, offering a self-custodial wallet, onchain swaps, and perpetual trading for crypto and tokenized real-world assets. Read more.

MARKETS

Gate Enables USDCx Deposits and Withdrawals on Canton Network, Adds $150,000 CC Incentive Campaign: Gate has enabled USDCx deposits and withdrawals on Canton Network and launched a $150,000 CC incentive campaign spanning spot trading, deposit challenges, and fixed-term savings products. Read more.

Canton Network Tops Global Protocol Rankings by Revenue With $63.9 Million in 30 Days: Canton Network has topped DeFiLlama's global protocol rankings by 30-day revenue, generating $63.9 million as its 100% fee burn model returns the entirety of network activity to participants. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Bitwise Launches Canton ETP on Deutsche Börse Xetra: Bitwise has launched the Bitwise Canton ETP on Deutsche Börse Xetra, giving investors exchange-traded exposure to CC, the native token of Canton Network. The product is issued by Bitwise Europe GmbH in Germany and is fully backed by CC tokens held in cold storage. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 23, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of June 01–07, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of June 01–07, 2026.

ECOSYSTEM

EQ Market Launches on Testnet, Bringing Native Credit Markets to Canton Network: EQ Market has launched on testnet with a CC and USDCx supply-and-borrow market, marking the first public release of a native lending protocol on Canton Network ahead of a planned mainnet launch. Read more.

Canton Network Welcomes 16 New Validator Operators: Canton Network has welcomed 16 new validator operators, including Nipro, Silverlake, and Chainbase among the more established names joining its growing institutional infrastructure base. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Mastercard Includes Canton in Stablecoin Settlement Expansion: Mastercard has listed Canton among the blockchain networks expected to support regulated stablecoin settlement as it expands card-network settlement options across fiat, intraday, weekend, holiday and on-chain rails. Read more.

Shinhan Financial Group Signs Canton Network MOUs to Bring Korean Assets to Global Investors: Shinhan Asset Management and Shinhan Investment & Securities have each signed MOUs with Canton Foundation, aiming to use Canton Network's global institutional infrastructure to distribute Korean tokenized financial products to overseas investors. Read more.

Visa and Brale Explore Private Stablecoin Settlement on Canton: Visa is working with Brale on a proof of concept using SBC, a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Brale, to evaluate privacy-enabled settlement for institutional payment flows on the Canton Network. Read more.

KB Securities Signs MOU With Canton Foundation And Wavebridge To Build Distributed-Ledger-Based Digital Asset Infrastructure: KB Securities said it signed an MOU with the Canton Foundation and Wavebridge to jointly review distributed ledger-based infrastructure for domestic capital market transactions using the Canton Network. Read more.

Grayscale Files S-1 for Canton Coin ETF: Grayscale has filed a Form S-1 with the SEC for the Grayscale Canton ETF, a proposed exchange-traded product designed to provide exposure to Canton Coin. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Noves Launches Public Data Studio for Canton Network: Noves has launched a public Data Studio for Canton Network, providing unified visibility into network activity, app economics, compliance data, and validator flows. Read more.

CIP-0117 Approved: Canton Network Eliminates Multi-Hour Downtime for Protocol Upgrades: Canton Network has approved CIP-0117, replacing multi-hour coordinated protocol upgrade halts with Logical Synchronizers that cut switchover downtime to seconds, with MainNet upgrade scheduled for June 27. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 24, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of June 08–14, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of June 08–14, 2026.

TECHNOLOGY

PartyLayer Integrates WalletConnect to Expand Canton Wallet Connectivity: PartyLayer has integrated WalletConnect into its open-source wallet connectivity and developer experience layer for Canton dApps, giving developers an additional connection path alongside its existing multi-wallet support, CIP-0103-aligned interface, React tooling, and registry-based wallet discovery. Read more.

CIP-0112 Approved: Canton Network Upgrades Its Core Token Standard: Canton Network has approved CIP-0112, upgrading its core token standard with privacy-enhanced batch settlement, traditional custody chain support, and committed allocations for prefunded trading, while maintaining full backwards compatibility with V1. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Hacken Becomes Official Auditing Provider for Canton Network: Hacken has been named an official auditing provider for Canton Network, with dedicated Daml certification and published security research supporting its role in reviewing smart contracts and infrastructure for institutional Canton applications. Read more.

EDELx Lists on OneSwap as Edel Finance Becomes Latest Canton App to Embed the Protocol: EDELx is now live on OneSwap, and Edel Finance has integrated the OneSwap SDK into its platform, making it the latest Canton application to embed permissionless swap functionality natively. Read more.

Send Launches Browser Extension to Connect Users to Canton Network Applications: Send has launched Send Connect, a Chrome browser extension that brings a native wallet experience to Canton Network, allowing users to connect to applications, approve transactions with passkeys, and interact with the ecosystem directly from their browser. Read more.

Temple Accounts for Nearly a Third of Canton Network's Daily Fee Burn: Temple Digital Group's order book generated 31.5% of Canton Network's total daily fee burn on June 11, 2026, making it the largest single contributor to network fee activity on that date. Read more.

Canton Network Welcomes 20 New Validator Operators, Including Citadel and Taishin Bank: Canton Network has welcomed 20 new validator operators, with Citadel LLC and Taishin Bank among the most prominent names joining the network's growing institutional infrastructure base. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

a16z Crypto Leads $355 Million Round in Digital Asset as Canton Network Draws Broad Institutional Backing: Digital Asset has closed a $355 million round led by a16z crypto, with backing from more than a dozen financial institutions across TradFi and DeFi, as the Canton Network continues to build institutional momentum across tokenized asset markets. Read more.

MARKETS

Canborsa Launches Beta as First Perpetual RWA DEX on Canton Network: Canborsa has launched in beta as the first perpetual RWA DEX on Canton Network, offering trading in tokenized stocks, gold, oil, and crypto with up to 20x leverage through a non-custodial interface. Read more.

Kraken Adds USDCx Deposits and Withdrawals on Canton Network: Kraken has enabled USDCx deposits and withdrawals on Canton Network, with spot trading to follow once liquidity thresholds are reached, as the exchange signals broader Canton ecosystem support ahead. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 25, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of June 15–21, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of June 15–21, 2026.

ECOSYSTEM

OneSwap Goes Live Inside Loop Wallet as First SDK Integration: OneSwap is now live inside Loop Wallet, marking the first wallet integration of the OneSwap SDK and allowing Loop users to swap Canton assets natively without leaving the wallet. Read more.

Ekiden Launches on Canton Testnet as Network's First CLOB-Based Derivatives Exchange: Ekiden has launched on Canton Network's testnet as the first CLOB-based derivatives exchange on the network, with several trading firms already integrated and mainnet to follow. Read more.

HandlPay Adds $USDC to Its In-App Bridge, Connecting Base & Polygon to Canton Network: HandlPay has added USDC support to its in-app bridge, allowing users to move stablecoins between Base, Polygon, and Canton Network directly inside the HandlPay app Read more.

HANDL Lists on OneSwap as HandlPay Becomes First Payments App to Integrate the SDK: HANDL is now live on OneSwap and HandlPay has integrated the OneSwap SDK, making it the first payments application on Canton Network to embed native swap functionality. Read more.

Hecto's Allocator Crosses 17,000 Daily Users, Emerging as a Breakout Consumer Application on Canton: Hecto’s Allocator has become one of Canton’s most active consumer apps, with 17,000+ daily users, 2.74M+ $CC distributed, and 18,000+ $HECTO holders. Built natively on Canton, the Allocator gives users a daily, non-liquidating way to engage with major private companies like OpenAI, SpaceX, Anthropic, ByteDance, Stripe, and Databricks. It is the first live stage of Hecto’s wider plan to bring signal, access, and settlement to the pre-IPO economy. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

a16z Opens Seoul Office With Crypto as First Priority for Asia Expansion: Andreessen Horowitz has opened a Seoul office and named South Korea its Asian strategic base, with crypto as the first priority, following its $100 million participation in the Digital Asset Holdings round backing Canton Network. Read more.

Canton Strategic Holdings Authorizes $50 Million Share Repurchase Program: Canton Strategic Holdings said its Board of Directors has authorized a share repurchase program allowing the company to repurchase up to $50 million of its common stock. Read more.

HIFI, DRW, and Marex Advance Onchain Repo on the Canton Network: HIFI, DRW and Marex completed an onchain repo transaction on the Canton Network using familiar institutional plumbing: Tradeweb RFQ execution, prime brokerage intermediation and U.S. Treasuries as collateral. The significance is not that repo touched blockchain. It is that blockchain was used without abandoning the market structure institutions already rely on. Read more.

Canton Strategic is Expected to Join the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 Indexes: Canton Strategic Holdings said it is expected to be added to the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 indexes after the latest Russell reconstitution, effective after market close on June 26, 2026. Read more.

T-RIZE Appoints Omar C. Bermudez as Product Director: T-RIZE Group Corporation has named Omar C. Bermudez as Product Director, tasking the former McKinsey digital product lead with building out the company's product function across its tokenization and decentralized risk modelling infrastructure. Read more.

Grayscale Names Canton Network Among Top Beneficiaries if CLARITY Act Passes: Grayscale has named Canton Network among four blockchains most likely to attract institutional capital if the CLARITY Act passes, citing regulatory certainty as the key unlock for institutional digital asset activity. Read more.

Yuval Rooz Says Tokenization’s Next Phase Is Coordinated Markets: At NGDA 2026 in Seoul, Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz said tokenization must move beyond asset issuance toward coordinated financial infrastructure, with Canton positioned as a network-of-networks model for institutional markets. Read more.

Canton Weekly Roundup: Repo, Token Standards, Featured App Lockups and New Consumer Rails: Canton’s week brought movement across institutional markets, protocol upgrades, wallets, DeFi, Featured App economics and consumer-facing applications. title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 26, 2026

Canton Network news for the week of June 22–28, 2026.

TECHNOLOGY

Rapid Chain Aims to Bridge EVM Liquidity and Canton Infrastructure: Rapid Chain is building an EVM-compatible execution layer on Canton Network, pairing familiar wallets, Solidity tooling and cross-chain liquidity with Canton’s validation and settlement infrastructure. Read more.

OneSwap Wallet Is Live on Canton: OneSwap Wallet brings self-custody, local signing, Google-backed recovery, token transfers, swaps, incoming offers, and balance tools to Canton users. Read more.

Noves and RedStone Partner to Bring Institutional Price Feeds to Canton Network: Noves and RedStone have partnered to bring stablecoin and tokenized fund price feeds into the Noves Data Platform on Canton Network, supporting institutional mark-to-market valuation and reporting while preserving Canton's privacy model. Read more.

IntellectEU Launches CatalyX Package Manager 2.1 for Canton Network: IntellectEU has launched CatalyX Package Manager 2.1, adding private distribution, access control, and flexible hosting options to its Daml package management platform for Canton Network participants. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

T-RIZE Locks 30M $CC Across Two Canton Featured Apps Under CIP-0116: T-RIZE has locked 30,000,000 $CC across two Canton Network Featured Apps under CIP-0116, funding positions in tokenization, risk analytics and decentralized ML/FL. Read more.

Bithumb Lists Canton Coin ($CC) on Korean Won Market: Bithumb has listed Canton Coin ($CC) on its KRW market, expanding the token’s presence in one of the world’s most active crypto markets. Read more.

HECTO Now Available for Trading on Cantex: HECTO, the utility token of Hecto Finance, is now live for trading on Cantex, expanding access to a Canton-native asset focused on prediction markets, tokenized private equity exposure and compliance-first private market infrastructure. Read more.

Palladium Labs Launches 10 Million CC Genesis Fund to Support Canton Network Builders: Palladium Labs has launched the Genesis Fund, a 10 million CC grant program worth approximately $1.5 million, to support builders developing financial applications, infrastructure, and tooling on the Canton Network. Read more.

CIP-0116: Canton’s Shift From Incentives to Accountability: Weeks after CIP-0116 was approved, Canton projects are locking CC to maintain Featured App status, showing how the rule is turning commitment into action. Read more.

Canton Weekly Roundup: Funding Rails, Wallets, RWA Updates and $CC Locking: Canton Network saw movement across USD funding, exchange access, RWA infrastructure, wallets, $CC locking, liquidity, builder funding and app upgrades. Read more.

Canton Strategic Launches Locking Service for Canton Coin Commitments: Canton Strategic Holdings is introducing a locking-as-a-service offering for Canton Network app builders and Super Validators. The service follows CIP-0105 and CIP-0116, helping participants meet Canton Coin commitment requirements while managing capital more efficiently. Read more.

Moonsong Labs Joins Canton Ecosystem as Deployment Partner: Moonsong Labs has joined the Canton Network ecosystem as a Service Provider and released a free Canton Readiness Guide. Its Canton practice supports institutions with Daml development, node setup, compliant asset workflows, and Global Synchronizer integration. Read more.

Temple and HIFI Bring USD Funding and Settlement to Canton: Temple Digital Group is partnering with HIFI to let eligible customers fund Canton wallets from bank accounts, convert USD into USDCx, trade on Temple, and withdraw through HIFI-supported banks. Read more.

Zenith Invited to Japanese Megabank Consortium to Tokenize $1.6 Trillion JGB Repo Market on Canton Network: Zenith has joined Progmat’s Tokenized JGB / On-chain Repo Working Group, a DCC initiative studying tokenized Japanese Government Bonds, stablecoin cash legs, and on-chain repo settlement. Read more.

T-RIZE Adopts Chainlink for Onchain Proof of Insurance on Canton: T-RIZE has integrated Chainlink into its Kairos Digital Loan Notes programme, giving authorized participants a way to verify insurance coverage data for tokenized private-credit assets on Canton Network. Read more.

SK Securities to Leverage Cantor8 and Canton Through Edena MOU: SK Securities has signed an MOU with Edena Korea to expand its digital asset finance business, with the collaboration set to leverage Cantor8 and Canton Network infrastructure for RWA tokenization and STO-focused initiatives. Read more.

Canton Network Leads All Blockchains in 30-Day Revenue: Canton Network has recorded $59.91 million in 30-day revenue according to DeFiLlama data, ranking it among the top revenue-generating blockchain protocols globally and ahead of Tron and Ethereum by a substantial margin. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 27, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of June 29–05, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of June 29 – July 05, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

Canton Network Goes Live With Logical Synchronizer Upgrades: Canton Network has launched Logical Synchronizer Upgrades on Mainnet with Canton 3.5, introducing parallel synchronizer infrastructure, automatic validator switchover, preserved historical data, and smoother protocol upgrades. Read more.

TermPrime Goes Live on Canton With Fixed-Rate Institutional Financing: Term Structure Labs has launched a permissioned fixed-rate financing venue on Canton Network after completing an early seven-day transaction using CBTC collateral and Canton Coin. Read more.

Canton Foundation to Sponsor WebX2026 in Tokyo as Platinum Partner: The Canton Foundation has been confirmed as a platinum sponsor of WebX2026 in Tokyo on July 13 and 14, marking a direct push to engage Japanese and Asian institutional markets around Canton Network's blockchain infrastructure. Read more.

Tradeweb Facilitates Landmark On-Chain U.S. Treasuries Transaction on the Canton Network: Tradeweb, Franklin Templeton, Virtu Financial, Digital Asset, Societe Generale, and Blockdaemon completed a real-time on-chain U.S. Treasury-for-cash trade settled via the Canton Network, marking a milestone for tokenized real-world assets and 24/7 market infrastructure. Read more.

Canborsa Expands Asset List and Boosts Leverage as DEX Exits Beta: Canborsa has exited beta with an expanded tokenized equity list including Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet, and Amazon, leverage increased to 30x, and a restructured points programme rewarding trading volume directly. Read more.

Nexode Launches on Canton With USDCx Trader Rewards: Nexode Prediction Market is live on Canton Network with a $5 USDCx welcome reward and a weekly $100 USDCx leaderboard pool. Read more.

Temple: The Trading Engine at the Heart of Canton: Canton is building the rails for tokenized finance. Temple is building Private and compliant financial market infrastructure for the world's institutions on the Canton Network. Read more.

Walley Adds USDCx Bridge and In-App Swaps for Canton Users: The K2F Labs self-custody wallet now provides direct access to the USDCx Bridge and supported token swaps within a single Canton interface. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 28, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of July 06–12, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of July 06–12, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

Seven Days to Go: DTCC's Tokenization Service Prepares for Live Trading on Canton Network: DTCC will launch its tokenization service on the Canton Network on July 13, enabling the first live blockchain trading of DTC-custodied U.S. Treasury securities. The rollout marks a major step in bringing traditional financial assets on-chain, with a full launch planned for October 2026. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

NETSTARS and Canton Foundation Sign MOU to Explore Web3 Payments: NETSTARS and Canton Foundation have signed an MOU to explore Web3-based payment solutions, including stablecoin payments, with privacy, interoperability and compliance as core priorities. Read more.

Turnkey Brings Secure Key Management and Signing Infrastructure to Canton Network: Turnkey now supports Canton Network, providing developers with enclave-backed key management, Party registration, and transaction signing through a single API, removing the need to build custom signing infrastructure for Canton applications. Read more.

x402 Payments Go Live on Canton Network: FTP Tech has brought x402 payments to Canton Network, enabling APIs to charge per request and settle payments on-ledger in Canton Coin. Read more.

Digital Asset Co-Founder Outlines Plan to Extend CC Burning to Every Canton Synchronizer: Digital Asset co-founder Shaul Kfir has outlined plans to extend CC burning and validator rewards to all Canton synchronizers, with a CIP draft due in September and rollout targeted for the first half of 2027. Read more.

MARKETS

OKJ to Add Canton Coin (CC) on July 15: OKJ will begin supporting Canton Coin (CC) on July 15, 2026. Exchange trading, brokerage purchases, recurring purchases, deposits and withdrawals will be available. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 29, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of July 13–19, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of July 13–19, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

Grayscale Names Canton Among Five Networks Positioned for Tokenized Equities: Grayscale says Canton Network is positioned to benefit as equity tokenization moves into regulated market infrastructure. Ethereum, Solana, BNB Chain and Avalanche could capture other parts of the market as three ownership models develop. Read more.

Digital Asset / Canton Joins 54-Firm UK Wholesale Tokenisation Taskforce: Digital Asset / Canton is among 54 firms supporting a UK programme to move wholesale-market tokenisation beyond pilots and into live markets. The taskforce will begin with tokenised repo and establish nine Action Groups over the next 12 months. Read more.

DTCC Says DTC-Held Asset Conversions Occurred on Canton and Hyperledger Besu: DTCC says assets held at DTC were converted into tokens used in real production trades. The digital conversions occurred on Canton, a public network, and Hyperledger Besu, DTCC’s private network. Read more.

Hanwha Invests KRW 30 Billion in Digital Asset Holdings, Plans Canton Network Participation: Hanwha Investment & Securities has completed an approximately KRW 30 billion strategic investment in Digital Asset Holdings LLC and plans to participate in the Canton Network ecosystem. Read more.

Canton Strategic Releases Q2 2026 Canton Network Ecosystem Report: Canton Strategic Holdings released its second-quarter Canton Network ecosystem report, covering governance developments, institutional adoption and application-layer expansion. A public webinar will be held on July 22. Read more.

Canton Network Q2 2026: A Deep Dive Into Transactions, Apps and Validators: Canton Strategic Holdings' Q2 report says Canton Network averaged 2.28 million daily transactions, Featured Apps increased from 47 to 107, and approximately 200 new Validators launched. This deep dive examines the reported activity, institutional transactions, application growth, governance changes and data qualifications behind those figures. Read more.

Visa Stablecoin Platform Launch Adds Weight to Canton Network's Institutional Momentum: Visa has launched the Visa Stablecoin Platform for institutional stablecoin issuance and management, extending a year of stablecoin infrastructure development that includes becoming a Canton Network Super Validator and testing private stablecoin settlement on the network. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Edel Finance Prepares Canton-Native Perpetuals Venue for Tokenized Assets: Edel Markets is expected to launch later this quarter as a Canton-native perpetuals venue for tokenized equities, commodities and future multi-asset markets. Its design combines private positions, order-book execution, API access and onchain settlement. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Temple Digital Group and BitGo Partner to Bring Qualified Custody to Tokenized Assets on Canton Network: Temple Digital Group and BitGo have partnered to bring regulated custody through BitGo Bank and Trust to tokenized assets on Canton Network, giving institutional clients access to capital markets through Temple alongside a qualified custody solution they can trust. Read more.

Canton Network Powers Part of DTCC's Multi-Chain Tokenization Push, Balchunas Says: Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas confirmed the Canton public chain is being used in DTCC's latest tokenization project, alongside Hyperledger Besu, as part of a multi-chain strategy involving more than 40 firms including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Temple Digital Group Executes Onchain US Treasury Repo Trade on Canton Network via DTCC Tokenization Service: Temple Digital Group participated in one of the first onchain US Treasury repo trades on Canton Network through DTCC's Tokenization Service, settling a tokenized Treasury against Circle's USDCx with atomic delivery-versus-payment, ahead of the service's expected October 2026 launch. Read more.

Cashen Passes 50 Platforms as Canton Network's Credit Marketplace Gains Traction: Cashen, the bilateral CC delegation marketplace backed by Cumberland DRW company Ergonia, has passed 50 platforms onboarded, cementing its position as one of the fastest growing startups on Canton Network by dollar value and the leading destination for locking CC under CIP-0116. Read more.

Agentic Trading Infrastructure on Canton Network: Silvana is an agent interaction layer for tokenized assets on Canton Network, providing an orderbook, developer tools, and infrastructure for automated trading workflows. The platform supports four trading pairs, more than 100 deployed agents, and over 3,000 onboarded traders, alongside an ongoing campaign with Edel Finance. Read more.

excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of July 20–26, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of July 20–26, 2026.

Canton Network Has Burned 4.3 Billion Canton Coin Since Launch: Canton Network has burned 4.3 billion CC since mid-2024, worth more than $500 million, with daily burns accelerating and a CIP draft expected in September that would extend burning to every synchronizer on the network. Read more.

Ekiden Joins Canton Network as a Featured App: Ekiden has been approved as a Featured App on the Canton Network. The project is building institutional derivatives infrastructure on Canton, with a hybrid RFQ and CLOB model for efficient on-chain market execution. Read more.

OneSwap v2 Is Live on Canton: OneSwap v2 is now live with a rebuilt swap engine, single-transaction swaps, a built-in platform wallet, and prepaid gas support for lower network fees. Read more.

MARKETS

Premia Acquires Raven Market in All-Cash Deal, Absorbing Canton-Native Derivatives Infrastructure: Premia has acquired Raven Market in an all-cash deal, integrating the Canton-native institutional derivatives platform into its offering for 38 institutional clients managing more than $127 million in assets under management. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Digital Asset Adds Shinhan and Standard Chartered to Funding Round: Digital Asset has added Shinhan Financial Group and SC Ventures by Standard Chartered to its previously announced oversubscribed funding round, expanding its institutional investor base. Read more.

From DTCC to Corporate Treasury: Yuval Rooz Outlines Canton’s Next Phase: Digital Asset co-founder and CEO Yuval Rooz discusses DTCC’s first production activity, Canton mainnet extensions, network burn economics and a corporate treasury use case that could bring hundreds or thousands of businesses on-chain. Read more.

Hydra X Launches HX Gateway API to Speed Canton Deployments: Hydra X has launched the HX Gateway API, a REST layer for institutions and developers building on Canton without specialised Daml expertise. The company says it can speed go-to-market by up to 80% and cut deployment time by 50%. Read more.

Canton Strategic Holdings Sells Gravitas to Focus on Canton Network: Canton Strategic Holdings has sold its biotech R&D arm, Gravitas Life Sciences, to Gravitas Collective Corp. The board-approved deal closed on July 17 as the Nasdaq-listed company narrows its operating strategy around the Canton Network. Read more.

Nasdaq Pilots Tokenized Collateral on Canton Network as Q2 Earnings Hit Record Highs: Nasdaq disclosed a successful Canton Network tokenized collateral pilot through its Calypso platform during a record Q2 2026 earnings call, as the exchange operator reported $1.5 billion in net revenue, $1 trillion in index AUM, and the largest IPO in history. Read more.

Digital Asset Raises Additional $10 Million From Shinhan Financial Group and SC Ventures, Bringing Round to $365 Million: Digital Asset has raised an additional $10 million from Shinhan Financial Group and SC Ventures, extending its funding round to $365 million at a $2 billion valuation. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 31, 2026

Canton Network news for the week of July 27 – August 02, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

State of the Canton Network H1 2026: Key Findings from Palladium Labs: Palladium Labs’ 51-page State of the Canton Network – H1 2026 report maps the network’s growth across infrastructure, applications and institutional deployments, including more than 490 ecosystem participants and $9 trillion in monthly volume. Read more.

Canton Strategic Holdings Elects Three New Directors as It Advances Canton Network Strategy: Canton Strategic Holdings has elected Sean Galvin, Pamela L. Carter, and Rishi Nangalia to its Board of Directors, strengthening governance as the NASDAQ-listed company continues to build its Canton Coin-focused treasury and operating strategy. Read more.

SBI Rebrands Subsidiary to Build Financial Infrastructure on Canton Network: SBI Holdings has renamed SBI Security Solutions as SBI Digital Practice and reorganised the wholly owned subsidiary around Canton Network. The company will develop financial infrastructure and support institutional implementation in Japan and overseas. Read more.

Arqitech Deploys Canton Token Standard V2 for Institutional Cross-Chain Swaps: Arqitech has completed live institutional atomic swaps using Canton Token Standard V2, linking Canton Coin with assets on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and TRON without bridges or third-party custody. Read more.

Digital Asset Appoints Sylvain Bigaud as Senior Director of Global Business Development: Digital Asset has hired Sylvain Bigaud, formerly Regional Head of Middle East, Africa, and Turkey at Euroclear, as Senior Director of Global Business Development and Strategy, based in Dubai. Read more.

The Biggest In-Person Canton Network Hackathon of 2026 Comes to London: Cantor8 will bring university teams, developers and founders together on August 29 for a full day of building with Daml. Read more.

Chainalysis Explains Canton’s Privacy Model for Institutional Compliance: Chainalysis has identified Canton as the main example of sub-transaction privacy, where data is shared only with relevant parties while authorised stakeholders can receive access when needed. Read more.

Temple Lists Ember’s Physically Backed Gold and Silver Tokens on Canton: Temple Digital Group has listed Ember Protocol’s eXAU and eXAG for spot trading on Canton. Each token represents one troy ounce of fully allocated LBMA Good Delivery bullion held in professional vault custody. Read more.

Canton Network July 2026 Recap: Live Market Activity, Network Growth and New Products: July brought live institutional transactions, new investment, stronger network figures, product launches and wider access to Canton Coin across the growing global Canton Network ecosystem. Read more.

Console Ecosystem Locks 50 Million CC Under CIP-0116 Featured App Requirements: The Console ecosystem has locked more than 50 million CC across its four products under CIP-0116, reflecting a continued capital commitment to building practical infrastructure on Canton Network. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

BitSafe Launches Decentralization Manager for Canton Network, Backed by $1 Million Foundation Grant: BitSafe has launched Decentralization Manager in public beta, an open-source framework for distributed trust and custody infrastructure on Canton Network, backed by a $1 million Canton Foundation grant and already deployed by Palladium Labs, Nethermind, DSRV, and Finoa Consensus Services. Read more.

Canton Network news for the week of August 03–09, 2026.

MARKETS

Bitrue to List Canton’s $CC Token for Spot Trading: Bitrue will list Canton’s $CC token, with CC/USDT spot trading opening on August 4 and withdrawals becoming available the following day. Read more.

Franklin Templeton Becomes a Canton Super Validator: Franklin Templeton Digital Assets has announced its new role as a Super Validator on Canton Network, expanding its involvement from tokenized fund deployment into network infrastructure. Its potential Super Validator weight is tied to milestones covering treasury activity, 24/7 fund operations and production volume. Read more.

FOMO Pay Receives Canton Validator Approval: FOMO Pay has received validator approval on Canton and plans to use the network for institutional B2B payments and settlement. Read more.

BOOSTRY Plans Canton Multi-Chain Wallet With Digital Asset: BOOSTRY and Digital Asset are working together on a corporate multi-chain wallet scheduled for launch by the end of 2026, beginning with support for Canton. Read more.

1exchange Approved as Canton Validator for RWA Tokenization: 1exchange has been approved as a Canton validator and plans to use the network’s privacy-preserving infrastructure for future RWA tokenization, listings and trading. Read more.

Nano Labs Approved as Canton Network Validator: Nano Labs has been approved to operate a validator node on Canton, joining the network’s global validator ecosystem. Read more.

ISLA Joins Canton Foundation as Associate Member to Shape Digital Securities Finance Standards: ISLA has joined the Canton Foundation as an associate member, placing the securities finance industry's leading trade body inside Canton Network's collateral and technology working groups. Read more.

SBI Digital Practice and Nodeinfra Plan Japan-Korea Stablecoin Payment Network: SBI Digital Practice and Nodeinfra plan to develop the Musubi Project, a cross-border payment and settlement network built on Canton, beginning with yen and won test tokens. Read more.

Temple Digital Group and RedStone Partner to Bring Pricing Infrastructure to Commodity Markets on Canton: Temple Digital Group and RedStone have partnered to bring RedStone's institutional price feeds to Temple's newly launched gold and silver commodity markets on Canton Network. Read more.

PartyLayer Passes 106,000 npm Downloads and Announces Its New Roadmap: The open source wallet connection layer for the Canton Network crosses a six figure adoption milestone and sets out its plan for the next twelve months. Read more.

Zenith Demonstrates Canton-EVM Atomic Swap on Test Network: Zenith has demonstrated an atomic swap between a CIP-56 asset on Canton and an ERC-20 asset on Zenith as work continues toward EVM integration with Canton MainNet. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 33, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of August 10–16, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of August 10–16, 2026.

ANALYSIS

Canton Network Leads All Blockchains in 30-Day Fee Generation at $53.35 Million: Canton Network has generated $53.35 million in fees over the past 30 days, ranking first among all blockchains globally ahead of Hyperliquid and Tron, according to DeFiLlama data. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Rocky Exchange Wins HackCanton Season 2 as Umbra and Tirai Complete the Podium: More than 360 builders from over 60 countries took part in HackCanton Season 2, with Rocky Exchange finishing first ahead of Umbra and Tirai. Read more.

OpenZeppelin Opens Its Canton Development Stack to Public Review: OpenZeppelin has made early Daml components and reference architectures for Canton public, including CIP-112 token and settlement tooling. The materials invite developer testing, feedback and further implementation work. Read more.

Digital Asset Releases Canton 2.10.6 to Improve Post-Migration Reconnects: Canton 2.10.6 is a maintenance release that targets reconnect performance after hard domain migrations for PostgreSQL-based deployments with large active contract sets. It also updates dependencies to resolve Netty security issues. Read more.

CertiK Maps the Full Security Model Behind Canton Assets: CertiK’s new guide explains how CIP-56 gives Canton assets a common interface, while implementation, client transaction construction and interpretation, and operational permissions collectively shape their security. The piece focuses on the security boundaries that institutions and developers should assess. Read more.

Nuxaris: Private cross-chain bridge into Canton Network.: Nuxaris is a Canton-native, non-custodial bridge that enables private, bidirectional transfers between Canton Coin and supported networks including Solana, Ethereum and Base. It combines multi-wallet support with a simple route into and out of the Canton ecosystem. Read more.

Digital Asset Releases Canton 3.5.13 With CantonBFT and Traffic Enforcement Improvements: Digital Asset has released Canton 3.5.13, a maintenance update focused on CantonBFT and traffic enforcement. It refines how nodes retrieve missing batches during connectivity issues and adds new optional controls for participant operators. Read more.

Splice 0.7.2 Adds Session Key Support and Updates SV Voting: Splice 0.7.2 moves to Canton 3.5.13, adds official session signing key support for KMS enabled validator and Super Validator participants, and updates how SV votes are handled while requests remain open. Read more.

HackCanton Season 3 Opens Registration for Five-Week Online Builder Competition: HackCanton Season 3 begins September 10 and runs online for five weeks, with workshops, mentoring and a live Grand Final. Registration is open to solo builders and teams, with up to $50,000 in cash and credits listed for the event. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Broadridge's Blockchain Repo Platform Processes $8 Trillion in July, Deepening Ties to Canton Network: Broadridge Financial Solutions processed $8 trillion in repo transactions through its Distributed Ledger Repo platform in July, as the company continues to deepen its role in the Canton Network ecosystem, alongside a cross-border intraday repo transaction involving DTCC, Euroclear, Tradeweb, Citadel Securities, and Societe Generale settled on Canton. Read more.

Digital Asset CEO Says It Is Time for a Fuller Korea Entry: In an original BusinessPost interview, Yuval Rooz said he believes it is an appropriate time for Digital Asset to enter Korea in earnest, with institutional Canton use a priority. He cited insurance as a possible use case and said further announcements could follow in the coming weeks. Read more.

MUFG, Digital Asset and Progmat Launch Canton JGB Repo Pilot: MUFG and three group companies have joined Digital Asset and Progmat to launch a Canton proof of concept for Japanese government-bond repo transactions. It will explore simultaneous settlement of JGBs and digital money, together with a more automated repo lifecycle. Read more.

Canton Strategic Reports $1.5 Million in Second-Quarter Revenue: Canton Strategic Holdings reported $1.5 million in second-quarter revenue, including $191,226 from network validation and $1.3 million in other revenue, primarily from locking-as-a-service agreements. Read more.

Franklin Templeton Clears First Canton Treasury-Management Milestone: Canton’s Tokenomics Working Group has approved Franklin Templeton’s first CIP-0118 milestone as complete and approved it for the release of one unit of Super Validator weight. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Ember Treasury Is Live on Canton, With Trading on Cantex: Ember Protocol has introduced Ember Treasury (USTY), which it describes as tokenized U.S. Treasury bills for onchain markets. Ember says USTY is live on Canton and available for trading on Cantex. Read more.

Cancore’s USDCx–USDC Route Goes Live Between Canton and Ethereum: Cancore has made a route for USDCx on Canton and USDC on Ethereum available through an atomic settlement flow that it says keeps assets with counterparties until settlement completes. Read more.

Cantor8 Announces Taran Route to Gold, Silver and T-Bills on Canton: Cantor8 has announced that merchants using Taran App can exchange tokenized mobile money for gold, silver and Treasury-bill products on Canton through C8 Wallet. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

OneSwap Launches First 'Pump.fun-Style' Token Launchpad on Canton Network: OneSwap has announced the first Pump.fun-like token launchpad built on Canton Network, letting users create, add liquidity to, and trade tokens in minutes, with the platform going live soon. Read more.

Temple Goes Live on Token Terminal as Canton Network's Top Revenue Application: Temple Digital Group has listed on Token Terminal, making Canton Network's highest revenue-generating application publicly trackable on a major analytics platform for the first time. Read more.

Console Wallet Integrates LetsExchange API to Expand Canton Coin Swaps: Console Wallet has integrated the LetsExchange API, allowing Canton Coin holders to swap directly into stablecoins and EVM assets and fund their wallets from external networks, all within a single interface. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 34, 2026
