Canton Network news for the week of August 17–23, 2026.

MARKETS

Canton Coin Lists on SolCex: SolCex, the first centralized exchange launched on Solana, has listed Canton Coin (CC), giving traders a new venue to trade CC on the platform. Read more.

Interstice Digital Launches Cross-Chain Swap Engine Connecting Canton Network to Robinhood Chain, Solana, and Ethereum: Interstice Digital and FalconX have launched a non-custodial cross-chain swap engine connecting Canton Network to Robinhood Chain, Solana, and Ethereum, named a Featured App on Canton as institutional and retail liquidity paths converge on the network. Read more.

Canton Coin Now Available on Ledger, Bringing Institutional-Grade Asset to Retail Hardware Wallets: Canton Coin is now available natively on Ledger hardware wallets, opening CC self-custody to individual holders for the first time as the token moves beyond its institutional and validator roots. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

ChainSafe Launches x402 Facilitator for Native Data Monetization on Canton Network: ChainSafe has released the x402 Facilitator, open source infrastructure that brings account-free HTTP 402 micro-billing to Canton Network, enabling autonomous AI agents to discover, query, and pay for enterprise data in real time. Read more.

Canton Coin Goes Live on Bitstamp by Robinhood With USD and EUR Markets: Canton Coin is now available on Bitstamp by Robinhood, with CC/USD and CC/EUR spot markets open for trading. Bitstamp’s public data also shows Canton Network deposits and withdrawals are enabled, subject to regional access. Read more.

Canton Clarifies Featured App Rewards for Multi-Asset Transactions: Canton’s Tokenomics Committee has clarified how Featured App reward weight is calculated when a transaction includes more than one Featured Asset. Ordinary transactions share the available weight across those assets, while approved delivery-versus-payment venues use a separate calculation when both sides of an exchange settle together. Read more.

Canton Network Welcomes 10 New Validator Applicants Spanning Finance, Agriculture, AI, and Retail: The Canton Foundation has published its latest batch of validator operator submissions, covering 10 applicants ranging from AI agent payment platforms to RWA issuers and luxury retail, with a one-week window for concerns before implicit approval on August 26, 2026. Read more.

R1M Seeks Canton Featured App Status for Sentinel: R1M has applied for Canton Featured App status for R1M Sentinel, its validator-monitoring service. The team plans to introduce premium subscriptions paid in Canton Coin in early September. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Temple Trading Data Goes Live on Token Terminal: Temple Digital Group’s market data is now available across Token Terminal, giving users access to trading activity from the Canton-based platform. Read more.

CAC Launches Pactora With Canton Network Support: Japanese technology company CAC has launched Pactora, a multichain platform for issuing, managing and settling tokenized assets across Canton Network, Avalanche and Solana. Read more.

Canton Approves 17 Validator Operators and Issues New MainNet Allocations: Canton’s latest governance updates approve 17 validator operators, while a separate MainNet allocation notice expands access across 22 organizations and 26 allocation entries. Read more.

Digital Asset and American Idea Foundation Pilot Blockchain-Based Benefit Distribution on Canton Network: Digital Asset and the American Idea Foundation have announced a collaboration to pilot blockchain-based government benefit distribution using Canton Network, testing a unified, programmable system for delivering state RISE benefits to families across multiple assistance programs. Read more.

HSBC CST Receives Featured App Status on Canton TestNet: HSBC CST has received Featured App status on Canton Network’s TestNet after all 13 Super Validators supported the proposal. The right became active on August 21, adding another milestone to HSBC’s work across the network. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Canton Enables CIP-0104 Models and Featured App Weight Voting: Canton has enabled CIP-0104’s supporting Daml models and Featured App weight-voting interface on MainNet, advancing the network’s move toward traffic-based app rewards. Read more.

Canton Foundation Launches Super Validator Operations Calendar: The Canton Foundation has launched a web-based master calendar for Super Validator operations, giving operators and app providers a clearer view of upgrades, dependencies and planned network events. Read more.

Canton Development Fund Allocates More Than 162 Million CC Across 32 Proposals: Canton’s Development Fund has allocated more than 162 million CC across 32 approved proposals supporting protocol development, infrastructure, security and ecosystem tools. Funding is released as teams complete and pass their agreed milestones. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 35, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of August 24–30, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of August 24–30, 2026.

TECHNOLOGY

Alpend Completes Smart Contract Audit With Halborn Security: Alpend has completed a smart contract audit with Halborn Security, with all findings resolved ahead of the credit protocol's planned deployment on Canton Network. Read more.

IntellectEU and Noves Integrate Private Data Layer Into CatalyX, Closing a Key Gap for Institutional Canton Deployments: IntellectEU has integrated the Noves Data Platform into CatalyX Blockchain Manager, bringing private financial and operational data infrastructure into a single production environment for more than 100 active Canton validators. Read more.

HANDL Opens Founders Circle While Work on 2.0 Continues: HANDL has created a private group for long-term holders, builders and power users who want to work more closely with the team. Read more.

Edel Markets Moves Toward Public Beta: Edel Finance is preparing to bring Edel Markets into public beta through Supanova, giving the new Canton venue access to an app that reports 80,000 users. Read more.

Digital Asset Details Canton's Post-Quantum Security Plans: Canton plans to introduce security methods designed to resist future quantum-computer attacks over the next six to twelve months. Partners are already testing an experimental digital-signature option. Read more.

Canton Development Fund Approves Up to 1.61 Million CC for Hacken and BootNode: Hacken and BootNode have received approval for Development Fund grants totaling up to 1.61 million CC. The funding supports security monitoring and tools for Canton developers, with payments tied to milestones. Read more.

Canton Foundation Publishes Development Fund Roadmap Through 2028: The Canton Foundation has outlined 28 areas for development funding, including simpler account hosting, better tools for builders and stronger security. The roadmap also sets growth targets for 2028. Read more.

OneSwap goes live inside Slay Money: Slay Money users can now swap Canton assets inside the app through its OneSwap integration, without opening another tab or reconnecting their wallet. Read more.

ZeroVaultID Activates Validator on Canton MainNet: ZeroVaultID has activated its Canton MainNet validator. It is now seeking a partner for the first MainNet deployment of its privacy-focused compliance tools. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Vanguard and Wellington Test Tokenized Collateral on Canton: Vanguard and Wellington Management have completed their first tokenized collateral test trades on Canton. Nasdaq Calypso managed the process around each trade, while the collateral moved and settled on Canton. Read more.

World Liberty Financial Launches USD1 Directly on Canton Network: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin is now issued directly on Canton Network. Institutions can configure it as the dollar payment for tokenized assets, allowing the asset and payment to settle together. Read more.

Circle's USYC seeks Canton Featured App Status: Circle's USYC has applied for Featured App status on Canton, with Digital Asset as sponsor. The tokenized money-market fund is already live on the network. Read more.

Virtu Financial, M1X Global, and Tradeweb Complete First Fully On-Chain Repo Using Sovereign Digital Bond on Canton Network: Virtu Financial, M1X Global, and Tradeweb have completed the first fully on-chain repo using a natively issued sovereign digital bond as collateral on Canton Network, settling the full cycle atomically in under 10 minutes without prime broker intermediation. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Cenote Moves Under Kintsu as Canton Credit Platform Becomes Kintsu Capital Markets: Kintsu is bringing Cenote’s Canton-focused credit work into its wider platform. The Cenote brand will retire, while the product under development continues as Kintsu Capital Markets. Read more.

Console Wallet Launches First Visa Card on Canton Network, Allowing Direct Spending of Canton Coin: Console Wallet has launched the first Visa card on Canton Network following successful initial testing, allowing users to spend Canton Coin directly at any card-accepting merchant through Apple Pay or Google Pay. Read more.

Cantex Launches Cantex Connect, Bringing Wallet-Agnostic Trading to Its Exchange: Cantex has introduced Cantex Connect, allowing any wallet in the Canton ecosystem that supports a transfer memo to trade on Cantex through a native token transfer, with no permissioned integration, browser extension, or SDK required. Read more.

Temple Approved for DvP Treatment on Canton: Temple has received approval for DvP treatment on Canton. The decision covers qualifying trades where the asset and payment settle together in a single transaction. Read more.

Canborsa Enables Canton Coin as Collateral, Deepening Its Canton Network Integration: Canborsa now supports Canton Coin as collateral for perpetual trading, allowing users to trade CC/USDCx with up to 5x leverage. The update expands Canton Coin utility in the Canton ecosystem with new trading rewards and quests. Read more.

Hecto Reveals Its Next Three Products on Canton: Hecto has set out its next three product routes, with Predictions V2, PMX and Vaults built for different parts of the private-market audience. Read more.

Alpend Integrates Temple for Collateral Management on Canton: Alpend has integrated Temple's trading system into its early-access lending market. The connection will support collateral sales during liquidations, with the aim of improving recoveries. Read more.

Sixteen Validator Applications Open for Canton Review: Sixteen organizations have applied to operate Canton validators, with community review open until September 2. Their plans include wallets, tokenized assets and services for financial institutions. Read more.

mperps Introduces Canton Perpetual Trading With Aster: mperps has introduced perpetual trading with Aster, with account balances recorded on Canton. Access requires an invitation code, while Hyperliquid and Lighter are planned additions. Read more.

HANDL adds EDEL transfers between Base and Canton: HANDL users can now move EDEL between Base and Canton inside the app. The bridge expands the existing options to receive, hold and swap Edel's token on Canton. Read more.

Canton Foundation Development Fund adopts rules for AI assisted proposals: A new policy sets out how contributors can use AI for Development Fund work, including funding proposals, code and milestone submissions. Read more.

Cantex Trading Volume Passes $200 Million: Cantex has reported more than $200 million in cumulative trading volume, just over eight days after announcing its $150 million milestone. The update follows the launch of Cantex Connect, which lets compatible Canton wallets trade without opening the platform’s interface. Read more.

OKJ Launches Canton Coin Quiz With 70,000 CC in Rewards: OKJ has opened a ten-question Canton Coin quiz running until September 18. Participants who answer at least seven questions correctly can share 60,000 CC, with another 10,000 CC reserved for ten selected qualifiers. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

BitSafe’s CBTC Goes Live on Swap Monster Across Four Canton Markets: BitSafe’s CBTC is now available on Swap Monster against CC, USDCx, EDELx and TRAKXRWA. The venue lets eligible institutional participants trade through private quotes while keeping assets in their wallets until a price is accepted. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 36, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of August 31–06, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of August 31 – September 06, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

Hanwha Plans Its First Tokenized Product on Canton: Hanwha Investment & Securities is preparing a Canton-based product issuance as it develops a digital-asset platform initially aimed at professional investors. Read more.

DTCC Tokenization Service Set for October Commercial Launch After July Production Trades: DTCC's tokenization service is set for commercial launch in October 2026 following successful July production trades on Canton Network, with more than 50 institutions including BlackRock, JPMorgan, and Goldman Sachs participating in the Industry Working Group. Read more.

FinTech Magazine Names Digital Asset Among Its Top 10 Digital Asset Platforms: Digital Asset has been included in FinTech Magazine’s Top 10 Digital Asset Platforms, with Daml and Canton highlighted as central parts of the company’s work. Read more.

HashKey Joins DTCC Tokenization Working Group as First Asian Digital Asset Provider: HashKey Group has joined DTCC's tokenization working group as its first Asian digital asset provider, ahead of DTCC's planned October 2026 commercial service launch on Canton Network and Hyperledger Besu infrastructure. Read more.

Fireblocks Maps Out Institutional Collateral Workflows on Canton: Fireblocks has published a practical guide to the Canton tools it supports for institutional collateral workflows, covering custody, wallets, validator options, contract calls, transaction approvals and reporting. Read more.

TreasurySpring’s $4 Billion Canton Plan Enters Governance Vote: TreasurySpring’s Super Validator proposal has entered formal Canton voting. It begins with a $10 million Fixed Term Fund target and lays out a proposed path to $4 billion outstanding on Canton within 12 months of approval. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

arCCade confirms Canton Featured App Status as early access nears: arCCade has confirmed its Featured App status on Canton Network as it prepares to welcome its first users. The waitlist is open, with the first access codes due to be distributed soon. Read more.

Sync Insights Launches Unified Workspace for Analytics, Monitoring, and Automation on Canton Network: Sync Insights has launched a unified workspace for Canton Network combining analytics, automated workflows, governance visibility, private transfer insights, and transaction parsing, building on a platform that has delivered more than 800,000 insights since June 2025. Read more.

Canton Loop Opens TestNet Trial for New Transaction Fee Model: Canton Loop has opened limited TestNet access to a new fee model that shows users the network cost before they approve a transaction. Read more.

DSRV Brings Canton Into ITCEN Group’s Live Cafe Payment System: South Korean infrastructure provider DSRV has moved ITCEN Group’s Cafe de CEN ordering and payment service onto Canton, connecting it with the group’s ERP for real-time order, payment and settlement processing. Read more.

Canton Approves 15 Validator Operators as 25 More Enter Review: Fifteen organizations can now begin deploying Canton validator infrastructure, while a new group of 25 applicants enters community review. MainNet access still requires a separate allocation. Read more.

Canton Development Fund Pays 9.37 Million CC Across Eight Milestones: The Canton Development Fund has paid 9,368,809 CC across eight completed milestones covering application rewards, token support, wallet infrastructure, testing, developer tools and governance. Read more.

Alpend Completes Major Protocol Upgrade on Canton: Alpend has upgraded its Canton money market with multiparty hosting, distributed protocol controls and a Halborn-audited codebase. The upgrade also raises supply caps and introduces Ascent 2 rewards for migrated positions. Read more.

Five North Launches Paid Plans for Lighthouse API: Five North has introduced paid Lighthouse API plans alongside its continuing free tier. The new structure offers different levels of access for projects using Canton data. Read more.

Digital Asset Releases Canton 3.5.16 With Reliability Improvements: Canton 3.5.16 is now available with reliability fixes, stronger timestamp validation, lower memory use during one internal process and expanded API documentation. Read more.

Digital Asset CEO Confirms September CIP Draft for Network-Wide CC Burning: Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz has confirmed that the Canton Improvement Proposal extending CC burning and validator rewards to every synchronizer on the Canton Network remains on track for submission this month, following earlier remarks from co-founder Shaul Kfir outlining the plan. Read more.

FTP Tech Resubmits Featured App Application for Canton x402 Payments: FTP Tech has resubmitted its Featured App application for x402 tools on Canton. The service lets AI agents pay for individual online requests from their own wallets using Canton Coin or USDCx. Read more.

Hashrupt Presents Six Verity Products on Canton: Hashrupt has presented six products built around Verity, its shared platform on Canton. They cover lending, treasury, invoicing, project work and fundraising, with additional Settla and Backr features still in development. Read more.

Ones Unveils Canton Business Account and Confirms MVP Is Ready: Ones has introduced a financial platform for individuals, businesses and AI agents. Its business account is being built on Canton and is designed to bring payments, cards, payroll, invoicing, treasury and team management into one place. Read more.

Squid Intents Launches Multi-Chain Swaps for Canton: Squid Intents is now live on Canton, adding routes from supported assets on 30 chains, new liquidity for CC swaps and integration tools for wallets and applications. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

French crypto platform Coinhouse adds Canton Coin: French crypto platform Coinhouse has added Canton Coin, allowing customers to buy CC with euros, then hold, sell or exchange it within their Coinhouse accounts. Read more.

Temple Digital Group and HIFI Partner to Enable Direct Bank-to-Canton Funding and Settlement: Temple Digital Group and HIFI have partnered to enable direct bank-to-Canton funding and withdrawal, allowing Temple users to deposit US dollars, trade on Canton, and withdraw back to their bank account 24/7 through HIFI's stablecoin conversion infrastructure. Read more.

Rocky Wallet Plans Support for Hecto Assets on Canton: Rocky plans to support Hecto ecosystem assets in Rocky Wallet and make the wallet available as a connection inside Hecto products. Technical details and release timing are still to come. Read more.

Tradecraft Reports More Than $3 Million in Canton TVL: Tradecraft reports that the total value locked across its Canton liquidity pools has passed $3 million. The figure measures assets held in the pools that support trading on the platform. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

eesee Outlines Plans for a Connected Financial Hub on Canton: eesee has outlined plans to connect its launchpad with portfolio tracking and vaults on Canton. The company reports 91 launches and more than $10.9 million raised through its existing launchpad. Read more.

South Korea Sets Roadmap for Tokenized Stocks, Bonds and Funds: South Korea will begin the first phase of its tokenized securities roadmap in February 2027. The plan starts with institutional funds and bonds, unlisted shares and fractional investments, with later phases planned for public securities and onchain settlement. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 37, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of September 07–13, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of September 07–13, 2026.

TECHNOLOGY

HANDL Plans to Route All Transactions Through Canton: HANDL plans to route all transactions through Canton for privacy as it prepares to begin the countdown to its 2.0 update. Read more.

CanTrustAI Adds Three Payment Options for AI Access on Canton: CanTrustAI now accepts USDCx, cETH and USDxlr for individual AI requests, expanding the payment options for its existing Canton-based service. Read more.

Canton approves 25 new validator operators: Canton has approved 25 validator applicants, including BLOSAFE, BTCS S.A. and InfraDAO. The operators can proceed with onboarding, with MainNet access requiring a separate allocation. Read more.

Lattice adds cETH to its Canton finance tools: Lattice now supports cETH, allowing finance teams to track balances, approve activity and reconcile wrapped ETH alongside their other Canton assets. Read more.

Zenith holds Tier 1 Super Validator status on Canton: Zenith combines its Tier 1 Super Validator role with work to bring Ethereum applications to Canton. Its participation spans network operations, governance committees and a development program with rewards tied to verified milestones. Read more.

Tenkai’s Canton swaps gain recognition under network reward rules: Canton’s Tokenomics Committee has approved delivery-versus-payment treatment for qualifying Tenkai swaps, building on the platform’s existing Featured App status. Read more.

The Tie examines where privacy belongs in Canton’s financial markets: The Tie’s final Canton report explores how financial transactions can remain private while giving authorised participants access to the records they need. Read more.

Canton Wallet SDK 1.5.0 improves token-lock handling: Canton’s wallet developer toolkit has been updated with better handling of expiring token locks, a public-registry access fix and a new trade example. Read more.

Edel integrates Alpaca’s brokerage and equity-data infrastructure: Edel has added Alpaca Markets’ brokerage and equity-data infrastructure as it develops products connecting traditional finance with onchain markets. Read more.

Canton 3.5.17 brings fixes for network operators: Canton’s latest maintenance release addresses memory-related crashes and connection problems, with additional improvements to processing and configuration. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Hanwha Positions Across Three Blockchain Layers as Korea Sets 2027 Tokenized Securities Roadmap: Hanwha Investment and Securities has completed a tokenized securities platform on Avalanche, completing a three-layer infrastructure position spanning issuance through Securitize, institutional settlement through Canton Network and Digital Asset, and secondary market liquidity through Avalanche, as Korea's FSC sets its 2027 tokenized securities roadmap. Read more.

LSEG Super Validator Proposal Opens for Discussion on Canton: A new proposal would bring London Stock Exchange Group into Canton’s Super Validator program, with milestone-based rewards and commitments reviewed by the network’s governance committees. Read more.

DSRV adds Canton Coin custody for institutional clients: DSRV has added Canton Coin to its digital-asset custody service, expanding its support for institutions and businesses using Canton. Read more.

Circle’s USYC clears committee review for Canton Featured App status: Circle’s USYC has cleared Canton’s Tokenomics review. A Super Validator vote is the next step toward Featured App status. Read more.

Broadridge launches DLX for tokenized markets with Canton support: Broadridge has launched DLX, bringing tokenized asset services into one platform with capabilities to connect to DTCC’s Tokenization Service through Canton and other networks. Read more.

TreasurySpring’s Canton plan wins approval with a $5 billion target: TreasurySpring’s approved proposal sets a 12-month target of $5 billion in outstanding fund shares recorded on Canton, with Super Validator rewards tied to delivery and ongoing activity. Read more.

Goldman Sachs Proposed as Super Validator on Canton Network in New Governance Proposal: A governance proposal has been submitted to designate Goldman Sachs as a Canton Network Super Validator with a maximum weight of 10, under a confidential milestone-based programme agreed with the Canton Foundation. Read more.

a16z crypto proposed for Canton Super Validator role: A new Canton proposal would bring a16z crypto into the Super Validator program, with up to weight 10 linked to agreed milestones. The draft was submitted on September 11. Read more.

Hong Kong Sets Out Roadmap to 3.5-Second Bond Settlement, With Canton Network in the Architecture: Hong Kong's Digital Bond Development White Paper 2026 outlines a three-stage roadmap to 3.5-second bond settlement by 2030, with Canton Network named among the chains the proposed ChainFusion clearing architecture is designed to connect. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Ekiden Goes Live on Canton Mainnet as First CLOB-Based Derivatives Exchange: Ekiden has launched its mainnet on Canton Network, becoming the first order book-based derivatives exchange on the network, with controlled access beginning with the top 100 traders from its testnet leaderboard. Read more.

HackCanton Season 3 Sets September 17 Start and October 21 Final: HackCanton Season 3 opens September 17, with submissions due October 9 and the Grand Final on October 21. Registration is open to solo builders and teams. Read more.

Swap Monster Adds cETH Trading on Canton: Swap Monster has added onRails’ cETH, bringing another trading option for ETH on Canton. Participants request private quotes, with payment and the asset settling together. Read more.

CC Leads Canborsa’s Latest Weekly Trading Update: Canton Coin was Canborsa’s most-traded asset in its September 7 weekly update, which included $1,187,222 in trading volume and 1,310 trades. Read more.

Canton Network Receives 22 New Validator Applications Spanning Finance, Infrastructure, and Real-World Use Cases: Twenty-two organisations have submitted Canton Network validator applications ahead of a September 16 deadline, including enterprise tooling firms, cross-chain RWA infrastructure providers, and a broad cohort of Indonesian applicants building specific use case templates on Canton's privacy architecture. Read more.

Cashen’s Canton Marketplace Grows to 65+ Platforms: Cashen’s latest figures show 65+ platforms onboarded and 330M+ CC in active locks across its marketplace for Featured Apps, Super Validators and institutional coin suppliers. Read more.

Cantex opens trading in four Trakx crypto indices: Cantex has added Trakx indices covering AI, DeFi, smart-contract blockchains and RWA-related tokens, giving traders access to four themed crypto baskets on Canton. Read more.

Canborsa opens Trading Arena with rewards of up to 16,000 USDC: Canborsa’s month-long perpetuals competition rewards the top 40 traders. Its prize pool starts at 300 USDC and grows to 16,000 USDC if total campaign volume reaches $40 million. Read more.

Canborsa adds dynamic funding and payment history: Canborsa has introduced funding rates that respond to market conditions, alongside a history showing traders the funding payments they have made and received. Read more.

Twelve organisations receive Canton MainNet validator allocations: Utila, BitSafe and Sats Terminal are among 12 organisations named in a new Canton MainNet allocation notice, with one validator node allocated to each. Read more.

Temple passes one billion CC burned on Canton: Temple has passed one billion Canton Coin burned for the network. The milestone follows its January trading launch and an expansion into markets including tokenized gold and silver. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Temple Opens Bitcoin and Gold Trading Pair on Canton: Temple has opened a Bitcoin and gold market on Canton, pairing BitSafe’s CBTC with Ember Protocol’s eXAU. The pair joins existing USDCx markets for both assets. Read more.

ANALYSIS

Canton Network Continues to Lead All Blockchains in 30-Day Revenue: Canton Network has generated $50.2 million in 30-day fees, continuing to lead all blockchains globally ahead of Robinhood Chain, Tron, and Base by a significant margin, according to DeFiLlama data. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 38, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of September 14–20, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of September 14–20, 2026.

INSTITUTIONS

Tokenovate Settles Intraday Repo on Canton Network Using USDC and Common Domain Model: Tokenovate has completed an intraday repo on Canton Network using USDC and the FINOS Common Domain Model, demonstrating programmable, privacy-preserving post-trade settlement on institutional blockchain infrastructure. Read more.

S&P Global Leads $110 Million Series B for Kaiko as Canton Foundation Joins Strategic Working Group: S&P Global has led a $110 million Series B expansion for Kaiko, with the Canton Foundation joining a new Strategic Industry Working Group on tokenised market data infrastructure, as Kaiko deepens its existing work with Canton Network on the iBoxx Treasury index and CC pricing benchmarks. Read more.

Digital Asset named in UK tokenisation feedback ahead of 2026 roadmap: Digital Asset Holdings (Canton) is listed among respondents to the UK’s consultation on tokenisation in wholesale markets. The FCA and Bank of England will use the feedback to develop a joint roadmap later this year, with collateral movement a leading priority. Read more.

Edel joins DTC’s digital assets working group: Edel has joined the industry working group helping shape the DTCC Tokenization Service. The Canton builder will contribute feedback alongside major financial institutions ahead of the service’s planned launch later this year. Read more.

Cashen Joins Canton Foundation Collateral Subcommittee Alongside DTCC, BNY, and Euroclear: Cashen, Canton Network's CC locking marketplace, has joined the Canton Foundation's Collateral Subcommittee chaired by DTCC, contributing to the Cross-Application Collateral Mobility workstream alongside BNY, Euroclear, and Broadridge. Read more.

Japan's FSA Names On-Chain Finance a 2026 Policy Priority as MUFG Tests JGB Repos on Canton Network: Japan's FSA has named on-chain finance its top 2026 policy priority, with MUFG's JGB repo testing on Canton Network already selected for the FSA's Payment Innovation Project as the regulator builds out the legal, institutional, and collaborative infrastructure for blockchain-based financial markets. Read more.

$EDEL is Finally Taking Its Rightful Seat at the Table: Edel Finance is deepening its role in institutional tokenization through its involvement in the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group and its growing presence in the Canton ecosystem. As traditional assets move onchain, $EDEL is positioning itself around the infrastructure, liquidity, collateral, and settlement systems that could shape the next phase of tokenized finance. Read more.

South Korean Asset Managers Build Digital Asset Infrastructure as Domestic Regulations Lag Overseas Markets: South Korean asset managers are launching digital asset ETFs abroad and building blockchain partnerships at home, including Shinhan Asset Management's agreement with the Canton Foundation, as they prepare for an expected opening of the domestic digital asset product market. Read more.

Kyobo Life and SBI Complete Cross-Border Yen-Won Stablecoin Test on Canton Network: Kyobo Life and SBI have completed a Canton Network pilot testing direct yen-won stablecoin exchange without a dollar intermediate leg, modelling cross-border institutional settlement in what Kyobo Life describes as South Korea's first such test by an insurer. Read more.

TreasurySpring Approved as Canton Network Super Validator to Record Fixed-Term Fund Share Ownership On-Chain: TreasurySpring has been approved as a Canton Network Super Validator, with the first milestone focused on recording Fixed-Term Fund Share ownership on Canton's ledger as the authoritative ownership register, with no change to the existing client experience. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

Utila highlights Canton in new blockchain privacy guide for banks: Utila’s new guide explores how banks can use blockchains while keeping sensitive financial information private. Canton features alongside Aleo and Zama, with a focus on controlling who can see transaction details. Read more.

Intercepta Integrates Compliance Engine With Canton Network for Real-Time Sanctions Screening and AML Checks: Intercepta has integrated its Compliance Engine with Canton Network, enabling real-time sanctions screening, AML checks, and fund flow traceability through designated observer roles within Canton's privacy-preserving architecture, without altering the network's underlying privacy model. Read more.

LYNC brings one-command deployment to Canton developers: LYNC has introduced canton-deploy, a tool that combines several steps needed to deploy an application’s Daml packages and set up users. Developers can also check deployments, inspect contracts and manage network configurations from the same tool. Read more.

Canton approves reward change for batched asset settlements: An approved change removes a cap that disadvantaged applications settling several trades together. The broader reward framework remains under review. Read more.

Canton 3.5.18 adds reliability fixes and a security update: The September 17 release improves catch-up, corrects misleading warnings and includes a security fix for node operators. Read more.

Loop brings prepaid network fees to Canton MainNet: Loop's Fee Balance is live on Canton MainNet, giving users a separate prepaid balance for transaction costs. The rollout also brings an update for applications that submit transactions from their own servers. Read more.

Cancore brings AI-assisted trading to Canton: Cancore MCP lets users turn a plain-language request into a proposed trade. The wallet supplies the live quote, and the user reviews and signs before any funds move. Read more.

Console adds individual balances for Canton network fees: Console users can now fund their own Canton traffic fees with CC or top up another participant's balance. The feature gives each account a separate way to cover its network usage. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

P2P Company seeks Featured App status for Canton escrow trading: P2P Company has applied for Featured App status for its live Canton escrow service. The platform supports peer-to-peer trades of CC, CBTC and cETH, with buyers paying sellers directly in stablecoins or local currency. Read more.

Temple Digital Group Launches Virtual Orderbooks for Custom Trading Venues on Canton Network: Temple Digital Group has opened up its Lightspeed trading engine to select institutions through Virtual Orderbooks, a primitive that lets operators deploy private, compliant spot, prediction, and perpetual markets on Canton Network. Read more.

Canton Network Receives 21 New Validator Applications Spanning Finance, Infrastructure, and Emerging Market Use Cases: Twenty-one organisations have submitted Canton Network validator applications ahead of a September 23 deadline, including interest rate swap infrastructure, undercollateralised credit markets, trade finance, yield routing, tokenised gold, and a broad range of Southeast Asian and emerging market builders. Read more.

Alpend and BitSafe add CC rewards for CBTC lenders: Alpend has partnered with BitSafe to reward CBTC deposits with Canton Coin on top of the interest earned from lending. Deposits remain subject to the pool's available capacity. Read more.

Ekiden passes $1 million in trading as early users get lower fees: Ekiden's invite-only MainNet has passed $1 million in trading volume across 15,978 trades. A temporary fee offer and new leverage limits accompany the milestone. Read more.

MARKETS

CC/USDCx Pair Goes Live on Kora's Permissionless Orderbook: CC/USDCx is now live for trading on Kora's permissionless orderbook, bringing together Canton Coin and Circle's USDCx stablecoin on Canton Network, with the pair available via xReserve. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Kora adds USDCx trading pairs for gold and silver on Canton: Kora users can now trade eXAU and eXAG against USDCx. The new gold and silver pairs follow a funding option that lets users move USDC from Ethereum directly into a Kora account. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 39, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of September 21–27, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of September 21–27, 2026.

TECHNOLOGY

Fairmint seeks 3.5 million CC for a Privy toolkit on Canton: Fairmint has applied for funding to connect Privy-based apps to Canton. The proposed developer toolkit would help those apps authorize transactions, with most of the requested funding tied to independent MainNet adoption and maintenance. Read more.

Float seeks Featured App status for its Canton swap service: The Slay Money team's Float service has applied for Featured App status. It compares quotes from exchange partners to swap more than 2,000 supported crypto assets into Canton Coin and back out again. Read more.

Rocky announces multichain wallet support beyond Canton: Rocky Wallet supports Canton, Solana and Ethereum-compatible networks in one interface. The update adds a combined view of balances, token transfers and app discovery, with multisig wallets still planned. Read more.

Splice 0.8.0 is ready for MainNet deployment: Splice 0.8.0 is ready for deployment on Canton's production network, with two-thirds of Super Validator nodes upgraded by the September 21 notice. The rollout combines software updates with later votes to activate certain features. Read more.

Five Canton apps clear Tokenomics review for Featured App status: The Hub, Upflam, Ubyx, WolfEdge Labs and FTP have cleared committee review. Super Validator on-chain approval is the next step in establishing their Featured App status. Read more.

Canborsa adds partial closing for perpetual positions: Traders can now close a chosen percentage or amount of a Canborsa position while keeping the rest open, with existing take-profit and stop-loss settings retained on the remainder. Read more.

Selay introduces Watcher for Canton project checks: Watcher lets users look up a domain, project name or Canton Party ID to inspect its classification, operator and on-chain evidence. Selay has released it as an early version without login or wallet-connection requirements. Read more.

Next Finance Tech receives one additional Canton MainNet validator allocation: Japan-based Next Finance Tech has received one additional MainNet validator node allocation. The September 21 award builds on the company's participation in Canton, which began in August 2025. Read more.

Hacken and NODERS schedule live AI audit workshop for Canton builders: A free online workshop on September 29 will review a real Canton smart contract with Hacken's AI Auditor. Builders will see how to examine possible security issues and plan fixes. Read more.

Canton Foundation sets 10-day update window for grant applicants: Applicants with open Development Fund proposals must identify the funding priority their work addresses and explain its benefit to Canton. Unchanged proposals face closure and exclusion from the next funding cycle. Read more.

CANAL adds PartyLayer wallet connectivity on Canton: CANAL and PartyLayer are working together to connect CANAL's asset platform with Canton wallets. The integration supports wallet connection, signing and transactions as CANAL develops its SOL-backed iSOL asset. Read more.

Tradecraft seeks DvP status after updating trade settlement: Tradecraft has applied for DvP venue status on Canton after updating how its trade orders settle. Both sides complete together, while a separate change to liquidity operations remains planned. Read more.

CCTools opens its data API as Temple TVL tracking goes live on DeFiLlama: Developers can now use CCTools data in their own Canton apps and dashboards. Its data feed is also powering Temple's total value locked figures on DeFiLlama. Read more.

Rocky adds independent checks for Canton trade settlements: Rocky Verification lets users check delivery-versus-payment trade settlements on Canton. The tool is available ahead of Rocky's wider MainNet launch and is the first application of its planned Canton Assurance Layer. Read more.

Cancore passes $50 million in cross-chain volume: Cancore has passed $50 million in cumulative MainNet volume between Canton and other blockchains. The milestone follows its public opening in May and the recent introduction of AI-assisted trading. Read more.

Canton 3.5.19 brings reliability fixes and a security update: The latest Canton maintenance release fixes memory and connection-handling issues, improves diagnostics and updates a software dependency to address a security vulnerability. Read more.

Ankr proposes a Super Validator role on Canton: Ankr has submitted a draft proposal for Canton Super Validator participation. Its plan ties a maximum reward weight of six to node operations, network activity and infrastructure for applications. Read more.

Rubic seeks 2.7 million CC for Canton swap-routing tools: Rubic has requested Canton Development Fund support for open-source tools that would compare token-swap routes across Canton exchanges. The 2.7 million CC proposal includes development, maintenance and an independent security review. Read more.

Bayzen’s Featured App application enters Canton MainNet vote: Bayzen’s Featured App application has moved to a MainNet vote after clearing Tokenomics review. The project is developing prediction markets for financial assets, protocol milestones and ecosystem events. Read more.

Zenith and IntellectEU work with TACEO on private Canton integrations: Zenith and IntellectEU are working with TACEO's Merces privacy technology for Canton applications and bank payment systems. The integrations form part of a wider rollout that began on Monad and World Chain. Read more.

Grofty previews Canton swaps across OneSwap and Cantex: Grofty's upcoming DEX will compare OneSwap and Cantex quotes, show fees before approval and let users choose their route. The preview also includes portfolio tools and bridging into USDCx. Read more.

Canton adds account-level tracking for network traffic costs: Local Traffic Management is live on Canton MainNet. Wallet providers and validator operators can track the traffic costs of individual accounts and choose whether to check balances before transactions are submitted. Read more.

Grisoco AI opens its Canton security-review beta to builders: Grisoco AI is inviting Canton developers to test its automated Daml security review. The beta examines permissions, privacy, shared-contract design and the effect of software upgrades. Read more.

ECOSYSTEM

Swap Monster announces Edel partnership for EDELx on Canton: Swap Monster has announced a partnership with Edel focused on EDELx, its Canton-side token. The update builds on earlier availability of a CBTC/EDELx market on the trading platform. Read more.

Silvana adds cSOL, QQQe and SPYe trading on Canton: cSOL, QQQe and SPYe are now available to trade on Silvana, adding three more assets to the platform's private trading markets on Canton. Read more.

Slay Money announces 6,000 CC for early users and weekly rewards: Slay Money plans to share 6,000 CC among 20 early users before its first weekly rewards distribution. Activity in the app begins counting this week, with the first weekly payout planned for next week. Read more.

Cantex announces $3 million in total value locked: Cantex's latest milestone puts its announced total value locked at $3 million. The Canton trading platform is also inviting institutions and eligible accredited individuals to apply as liquidity partners. Read more.

OneSwap's OnePump Is Coming Soon to Canton Network: OnePump, OneSwap's memecoin launchpad on Canton Network, is coming soon with two-minute token launches, no mempool sniping, and automatic liquidity locking. Read more.

Temple Launches Lightspeed 2.0 Matching Engine for Higher Trading Capacity: Temple has released Lightspeed 2.0, a major matching engine upgrade capable of processing over 85 million orders per day, settling 29x more trades per second, and matching orders in 3.6ms. Read more.

Canton Network Receives 60 New Validator Applications in Largest Batch to Date: Canton Network has received 60 new validator applications in its largest batch to date, including Mirae Asset Securities, Kore AI, Rome Protocol, and a broad range of professional validator operators and application builders spanning Southeast Asia, Singapore, Europe, and the Americas. Read more.

Titan opens waitlist for its planned Canton exchange: Titan has opened registration ahead of its planned MainNet launch. The exchange is building toward around-the-clock markets for crypto, equities and private assets, with privacy central to its Canton-based offering. Read more.

SwissBorg adds EDEL to its trading platform: SwissBorg users can now swap into EDEL from supported fiat currencies and crypto assets. The listing covers Edel's Base token and comes as the project expands its Canton-native stock offering. Read more.

Alpend Crosses $3 Million TVL as Credit Protocol Gains Momentum on Canton Network: Alpend has crossed $3 million in total value locked on Canton Network, reaching the milestone three days after crossing $2 million, as the credit protocol's lending and borrowing markets continue to attract inflows. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

a16z crypto approved for Canton Super Validator role: Canton's Super Validator operators have approved a16z crypto's participation. The arrangement links rewards and a maximum earnable weight of 10 to verified milestones. Read more.

LSEG Super Validator proposal moves to a formal Canton vote: Canton’s Super Validators have begun voting on LSEG’s proposed participation. The plan would let the group earn reward weight of up to 10 against confidential milestones. Read more.

Paxos Super Validator proposal reaches a formal Canton vote: The proposal ties a maximum Super Validator reward weight of 8 to native stablecoin issuance, reserve management and automated minting and redemption on Canton. Read more.

Canton Foundation sponsors Marex’s Super Validator proposal: The Foundation has sponsored a proposal for Marex to earn Super Validator weight of up to 10 through institutional settlement, collateral and other agreed projects. Read more.

Canton Foundation and KB Securities to discuss tokenized settlement at Bridge Seoul: Wavebridge's October 1 conference in Seoul will feature Canton Foundation and KB Securities in a session on cross-border payments and tokenized-asset settlement. Read more.

$CC: The Unstoppable Force of Ingenuity: Canton Network is gaining momentum as Visa, a16z, and DTCC deepen their presence in its ecosystem. With growing institutional participation, real tokenized asset activity, and expanding Canton Coin incentives, Canton is positioning itself as a key bridge between traditional finance and onchain markets. Read more.

Fireblocks Details How Citadel Securities Used Canton Network in DTCC's July 15 Tokenization Event: Fireblocks has detailed how it provided the infrastructure for Citadel Securities to tokenise US Treasuries on Canton Network and post them as collateral to CME during DTCC's July 15 production event, as the DTCC Tokenization Service prepares for its October 2026 commercial launch. Read more.

Nasdaq Connects Calypso Collateral Management to Canton Network as It Builds Toward Always-On Markets: Nasdaq is integrating its Calypso collateral management platform with Canton Network as part of its always-on market strategy, alongside planned 23/5 trading, a tokenized equity product, and a Kraken partnership, targeting a $3 to $6 billion market opportunity by 2030. Read more.

Digital Asset CEO Hints at Major Canton Network Milestone Next Week: Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz has suggested a significant Canton Network transaction could occur next week, hinting at a "first print" in a market he described as worth more than $100 trillion, separate from the DTCC Tokenization Service launch planned for October. Read more.

T-RIZE Joins Canton Foundation Collateral Subcommittee Alongside DTCC, ISDA, BNY, and Euroclear: T-RIZE has joined the Canton Foundation's Collateral Subcommittee, contributing to Cross-Application Collateral Mobility and Tokenised Repo and Financing workstreams alongside DTCC, ISDA, BNY, Euroclear, and Broadridge. Read more.

Canton approves 21 new validator operators: A new batch of 21 validator operators has cleared Canton’s approval process. The group includes teams working on tokenized gold, institutional credit, invoice funding and applications for businesses across several regions. Read more.

Paxos wins Canton approval for stablecoin and treasury plan: Paxos’s Super Validator proposal has passed with 12 votes in favor. Its milestones include a $20 million stablecoin issuance target, reserve management and round-the-clock minting and redemption on Canton. Read more.

LSEG wins approval for Canton Super Validator role: London Stock Exchange Group’s Super Validator proposal has passed with 12 votes in favor. The approved plan ties a maximum reward weight of 10 to confidential milestones and verified delivery. Read more.

Marex wins approval for Canton Super Validator role: Marex’s Super Validator proposal has passed with nine votes in favor. Its approved program links rewards to milestones covering institutional settlement, collateral and regulated financial activity on Canton. Read more.

Global Blockchain Projects Compete for Korea's Financial Market as Canton Network Deepens Institutional Ties: Six global blockchain projects including Canton Network, Solana, Chainlink, Avalanche, Optimism, and Plume are competing for South Korea's financial market ahead of the country's 2027 tokenised securities framework, with Canton drawing investment and validator participation from multiple Korean financial institutions. Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Rocky and Ember plan wider access to tokenized assets on Canton: Rocky and Ember will work together to expand access to real-world asset markets on Canton. The cooperation brings Ember's financial-product focus to Rocky's planned trading platform, with specific markets and timing still to be announced. Read more.

Cantex adds Edel's S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 tokens: SPYe and QQQe are now trading on Cantex, bringing Edel-issued, index-linked assets to another Canton venue. The tokens are debt instruments, with direct redemption available to verified institutional participants. Read more.

title: CANTON NEWS — WEEK 40, 2026
excerpt: Canton Network news for the week of September 28–04, 2026.
content:
Canton Network news for the week of September 28 – October 04, 2026.

ECOSYSTEM

Zenith Opens EVM Testnet to the Public, Bringing Ethereum Development to Canton: The Zenith EVM Testnet is live and open to the public. For the first time, 31800+ Solidity developers can deploy applications that compose atomically with Canton's $9T institutional infrastructure, using MetaMask, Foundry, Hardhat, and Remix, with no code rewrites and no bridges. Read more.

Alpend joins DeFiLlama with public tracking for its Canton lending markets: DeFiLlama now tracks Alpend's total value locked and active loans, with a published method explaining how the Canton lending platform's figures are calculated. Read more.

Temple reaches $30 million in daily trading volume on Canton: Temple's latest daily-volume update shows around $30 million in trading activity, following the release of its Lightspeed 2.0 matching engine. Read more.

Nuxaris opens cBTC and CC swaps on Canton: Nuxaris has introduced cBTC/CC swaps as the first part of its DEX rollout. More token listings are planned, with CBNB also announced as coming to Canton. Read more.

Tradecraft passes $2.5 million in trading volume over 14 days: Tradecraft's September 28 update puts trading volume above $2.5 million over the preceding 14 days. The figure measures trading activity on its Canton exchange. Read more.

Unhedged details referral rewards for its Canton prediction markets: Unhedged’s referral program gives inviters a share of eligible trading fees for 90 days, while referred users can receive up to $10 in fee rebates during their first 30 days of eligible trading. Read more.

Ibex adds cETH perpetual trading to its Canton beta: cETH-PERP is now listed on Ibex’s beta MainNet, adding a market linked to onRails’ ETH-backed token on Canton. Read more.

Canborsa reaches $35 million in total trading volume: Canborsa has reached $35 million in cumulative trading volume as its Canton-based platform continues to offer markets across crypto, stocks and commodities. Read more.

Cardiv seeks Canton recognition for its trading settlement model: WolfEdge Labs has requested delivery-versus-payment recognition for Cardiv, an exchange designed to keep assets in users’ custody and settle both sides of a matched trade together. Read more.

Slay Money proposes stablecoin settlement for Canton prediction markets: Slay Money wants to pair prediction stakes with a dollar stablecoin when a bet is placed, reducing exposure to CC or cBTC price changes before the outcome is settled. Read more.

Kairo and Askardex launch a 10,000 CC trading campaign: The campaign runs from September 30 to October 9 UTC, with separate reward pools for qualifying swaps and trading activity across multiple days. Read more.

Kaiko Deploys First Institutional-Grade Oracle on Zenith Testnet, Canton's Native EVM Extension: Ethereum applications deployed on Zenith gain regulated, multi-asset pricing data from Kaiko, the institutional data provider already trusted across Canton, Hyperliquid, and Wall Street's own Bloomberg Terminal. Read more.

Temple passes $1 billion in trading volume on Canton: Temple’s trading engine has processed more than $1 billion in volume, following an upgrade that expanded its order and settlement capacity. Read more.

SBI VC Trade offers Canton Coin rebates on recurring purchases: A VCTRADE campaign covers spread costs on eligible recurring purchases of Canton Coin, with rebates paid later in crypto. Read more.

Console, Cantex and OneSwap receive Canton settlement recognition: Tokenomics has approved delivery-versus-payment treatment for qualifying trades on the three venues under Canton’s Featured App reward guidance. Read more.

Canborsa adds clearer market data and trade controls: Canborsa’s latest update brings prices, market changes and collateral choices closer to the point where users open a trade. Read more.

Canton reaches 908,000 transacting parties in The Tie’s data: The cumulative number of distinct parties that have transacted on Canton has risen from 20,000 a year earlier to 908,000. Read more.

Canborsa Expands Canton Coin Utility, Enabling $CC as Collateral Across All Markets: The RWA perpetual DEX Canborsa lets traders use Canton Coin as collateral for any market, and launches a 14-day trading competition to mark the update Read more.

LetsExchange closes its swap service after earlier Console Wallet integration: LetsExchange stopped accepting exchanges on October 1. Earlier transactions will still be processed, and support is due to remain available through November 30. Read more.

Ekiden adds gold and silver markets on Canton: Gold and silver are now available on Ekiden during its closed MainNet phase. The new markets trade against USDCx and carry a 2× XP multiplier. Read more.

Cantex passes $300 million in trading volume on Canton: Cantex has reached $300 million in total trading volume, up from its $200 million milestone in August. The exchange lets users trade Canton assets while retaining control of their funds. Read more.

Ekiden passes $5 million in trading volume on Canton: Ekiden has reached $5,865,560 in cumulative MainNet trading volume while access remains invite-only. The milestone follows the addition of gold and silver markets to its Canton derivatives exchange. Read more.

Edel targets next week for EDEL staking with CC rewards: Edel’s October 3 update targets the following week for holders to stake EDEL and earn Canton Coin. It advances the timetable beyond the earlier promise to reveal participation details, without an exact opening date or yield rate. Read more.

TECHNOLOGY

HackCanton Season 3 draws around 450 builders from 48 countries: HackCanton Season 3 has recorded 353 registrations representing around 450 builders across 48 countries. The competition also includes a 10,000 CC Grofty bounty for projects that build a working wallet and onboarding experience on Canton MainNet. Read more.

Payvol resubmits 1.9 million CC funding request for simpler Canton payments: Cayvox Labs has resubmitted its Payvol proposal to the Canton Development Fund. The 23-week plan would create shared payment tools for Canton apps and wallets, with part of the requested funding tied to independent teams using them. Read more.

Canton's developer update brings easier troubleshooting and AI-assisted search: Canton's Q3 developer update covers new troubleshooting tools, an AI documentation assistant and a developer hub, alongside ongoing work to simplify application setup. Read more.

Canton advances Splice upgrades across MainNet, TestNet and DevNet: Fresh operator notices confirm Splice 0.8.1 for MainNet, 0.8.3 for TestNet and 0.8.4 for DevNet, with two-thirds of Super Validator nodes upgraded in each environment. Read more.

Grofty launches Lens to track Canton prices and trading activity: Grofty Lens brings Canton asset prices, liquidity and exchange comparisons into one dashboard, with data refreshed every minute and an API for developers. Read more.

Slay Money adds Exolix cross-chain swaps to its Canton app: Slay Money users can now exchange supported assets through Exolix without leaving the app. The integration adds cross-chain swaps to its Canton wallet, trading and prediction-market features. Read more.

Mystic Finance proposes a shared vault standard for Canton: Mystic Finance has submitted a Development Fund proposal for shared vault tools on Canton. The plan covers deposits, withdrawals and ownership shares, with funding tied to development and adoption milestones. Read more.

Temple adds Send Connect support for desktop trading on Canton: Send Wallet users can now connect to Temple on desktop through Send Connect. The integration adds another wallet option for trading on Canton. Read more.

CC Space brings its AI network explorer to Canton TestNet: CC Space is live on Canton TestNet with AI-assisted searches, network analytics, alerts and developer access. Users can browse without an account, with 500 free credits available after signup. Read more.

OneSwap launches bridge between Canton and eight networks: OneSwap’s Squid-powered bridge is live, giving users a route from supported assets on eight networks into Canton Coin and back again. Read more.

Alpend launches portfolio dashboard for its Canton lending markets: Alpend’s new portfolio view brings balances, interest, rewards and borrowing risk into one dashboard, alongside a record of past transactions. Read more.

SyncVotes renews Featured App request after its v2 upgrade: SyncVotes has updated its Canton Featured App application following a rebuild of its community-voting platform. The proposal would use application rewards to reduce members’ governance costs. Read more.

Canton awards another batch of MainNet validator allocations: A new allocation notice names 43 distinct organisations, including Upflam, Bayzen Tech, STAKR.space and Lo:Tech. The awards are issued in line with network capacity and health assessments. Read more.

Five North and Loop separate their brands as Loop Suite launches: Cantonloop becomes Loop Wallet and Lighthouse becomes Loop Data under the new Loop Suite. Existing wallets and balances stay unchanged, and moving to the new wallet domain is optional. Read more.

Digital Asset adds transfer verification on Canton, with Bybit integrated: DA Registry’s Proof of Transfer API lets users check a private asset transfer’s status through compatible explorers. Bybit and DA Registry have already integrated it. Read more.

Upflam prepares a privacy pool for Canton payments: Upflam is developing a deposit pool to make payment relationships harder to trace and has invited participants to help with its cryptographic setup ahead of launch. Read more.

ScopeX seeks Canton Featured App status for automated remittances: ScopeX is developing a Canton service that sends money to India when a chosen exchange rate is reached. Its Featured App application outlines a TestNet product and plans for a MainNet rollout. Read more.

Canton proposal would make Super Validator reward weights easier to track: A draft proposes recording individual reward-right holders and their allocations on the ledger, replacing information held in operator configurations. Read more.

C7 launches a searchable directory of Canton organisations: The public 7TRUST directory lets readers search by organisation, domain or Party ID and filter entries by credentials and network roles. Read more.

Kintsu previews lending and CC staking for its Canton private beta: The first beta wave will let participants supply USDC, borrow against Canton Coin and submit CC staking requests, then help refine the experience. Read more.

Grofty brings its Canton app to Google Play: Grofty has confirmed Android availability through Google Play. The app combines account management, asset transfers, an address book and transaction history in a mobile interface. Read more.

Canton opens MainNet vote for CantonBFT migration: A governance vote would schedule the MainNet move to CantonBFT for October 10. The proposed timetable separates the configuration change from the migration itself. Read more.

Titan launches its Canton testnet after opening its waitlist: Titan’s testnet is live on Canton, a week after the exchange opened its waitlist. The release gives users a first testing environment for its privacy-focused trading platform. Read more.

Primus Labs and HashCloak seek funding for private-data verification on Canton: The two teams have requested 1,303,500 CC for tools that would let Canton applications check facts from private web data without exposing the underlying information. The proposal remains open. Read more.

HackCanton Season 3 reaches 85 teams as submissions begin: HackCanton Season 3 now has 85 teams and 44 projects, with six projects submitted for judging. AppsFactory’s latest update also records 67 build diaries as teams approach the October 9 submission deadline. Read more.

Canal seeks Canton Featured App status after controlled iSOL pilot: Canal’s Featured App application sets out a controlled MainNet pilot for iSOL, its SOL-backed asset on Canton. Broader commercial use is targeted for mid-to-late October, subject to approval and integration readiness. Read more.

Tradecraft and C8 receive Canton settlement recognition: Tradecraft and C8 Wallet + RFQ DEX have received delivery-versus-payment recognition for Canton reward treatment. C8’s approval covers only its wallet and RFQ exchange, excluding Concordia. Read more.

Grofty expands Lens with portfolio tracking and developer tools: Grofty’s latest Lens update brings historical exports, shareable dashboards, portfolio tracking and price alerts together with developer SDKs. The October 3 announcement builds on its existing Canton market-data service. Read more.

Eight Canton apps clear Tokenomics review for Featured App status: Meridiant, Rocky Wallet, Jubilee, Selay Wallet, Wintip, SyncVotes, Nocturnal Wallet and BETH have cleared Tokenomics review. The October 2 notice makes them ready for Super Validator on-chain approval and does not itself activate their status. Read more.

INSTITUTIONS

Canton Foundation and Noves to Host Canton's First Institutional Forum in Korea Ahead of 2027 Token Securities Rules: Canton Foundation and Noves will host The Capital Forum in Seoul on September 30, Canton's first hosted institutional forum in Korea, as financial executives prepare for South Korea's token-securities framework taking effect on February 4, 2027. Read more.

Palladium Labs Joins DTCC Digital Assets Industry Working Group: Palladium Labs has joined DTCC's 100-plus member Digital Assets Industry Working Group, bringing a Canton Network builder's perspective on how tokenised assets function across lending, collateral, and settlement workflows. Read more.

Yuval Rooz calls for connected financial networks at Seoul's EastPoint conference: At EastPoint in Seoul, Canton co-founder Yuval Rooz argued for connecting networks that meet local rules, rather than waiting for countries to adopt one regulatory system. Read more.

Shinhan Financial Group CEO Meets Digital Asset Leadership in Seoul to Deepen Canton Network Partnership: Shinhan Financial Group's CEO has met Digital Asset and Canton Foundation leadership in Seoul to deepen collaboration across tokenised finance, digital asset infrastructure, and cross-border market connectivity, as Shinhan's group-wide Canton strategy takes shape ahead of Korea's 2027 token securities framework. Read more.

Canton puts connected markets at the heart of its KBW keynote: Canton Foundation president Viv Diwakar used Korea Blockchain Week to explain how tokenized assets could become more useful when institutions can trade and settle across connected systems. Read more.

Canton: The Orchestrator of This Institutional Masterpiece: Canton Network is rapidly connecting traditional finance with blockchain infrastructure. From major institutions and tokenized assets to expanding trading platforms and applications, Canton is building an ecosystem designed for real financial activity. The bigger story is how these pieces are beginning to work together on one global network. Read more.

Société Générale clears Canton tokenized-collateral milestone: Tokenomics has approved completion of Société Générale’s first CIP-0115 milestone, covering acceptance of tokenized assets as collateral on Canton. Read more.

Mirae Asset Securities among 60 approved Canton validator operators: Canton’s latest validator approvals include Mirae Asset Securities, Ankr Labs and Rome Protocol. MainNet access follows a separate allocation process. Read more.

Lloyds and Visa settle $750,000 in stablecoin pilot involving Canton: A seven-day trial moved USDC to Visa in under an hour, including over the weekend, with Lloyds using its own Canton node. Read more.

Seoul forum brings Korean institutions together around Canton plans: Shinhan Asset Management outlined its Canton strategy as financial institutions and infrastructure firms discussed preparations for production use. Read more.

Marex’s Canton Super Validator program moves to an implementation vote: A MainNet vote would put the hosted reward-weight arrangement for Marex’s approved Super Validator program into effect. Milestone rewards would still require verification and further governance approval. Read more.

Yuval Rooz puts institutional use at the centre of Korea’s digital asset opportunity: At RealFi X Asia in Seoul, Digital Asset’s CEO focused on institutions putting blockchain into everyday use, rather than treating regulation or tokenization totals as proof of adoption. Read more.

Swap.monster Joins the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group: Swap.monster has joined the DTC Digital Assets Solutions Industry Working Group (IWG), an industry forum convened by The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) to support dialogue, feedback and alignment around the DTCC Tokenization Service and the continued evolution of digital market infrastructure. Read more.

Zenith brings Korean institutions together at Seoul Table: Zenith co-hosted an institutional lunch during Korea Blockchain Week with Kaiko, Utila and Happyblock. Participants included Woori Bank, Mirae Asset Securities and Kyobo firms, with discussions covering tokenization and blockchain infrastructure for regulated markets. Read more.

Canton brings its connected-market case to Korea’s STO Summit: Canton Foundation president Viv Diwakar spoke at Korea’s STO Summit on October 2, explaining how connected financial systems could let institutions move collateral and settle transactions outside normal market hours. Read more.

Obsidian joins Canton’s collateral subcommittee: Obsidian has joined the DTCC-chaired Canton Foundation Collateral Subcommittee. Its planned contributions cover tokenized repo and financing, plus the acceptance of tokenized collateral by clearing houses and market infrastructure. Read more.

Noves plans Canton deployment talks in Tokyo: Noves plans meetings with Japanese financial institutions and infrastructure partners focused on Canton research, deployment design and partnerships. Its team will also join Pacific Meta’s Blockchain Summit on October 5. Read more.

LSEG’s Canton Super Validator plan moves to an implementation vote: An open MainNet vote would add LSEG’s hosted reward weight through MPCH following September’s program approval. The request targets October 10, while milestone rewards remain subject to verified delivery and further approval. Read more.

What a Slice of $114 Trillion Looks Like On-Chain: DTC holds more than $114 trillion in securities, and its tokenization service reaches commercial launch this month. Illustrative scenarios show what even a small share on-chain would represent, and why Canton's fee economics depend on activity rather than notional value Read more.

TOKENIZATION

Edel’s SPYe and QQQe reach $1 million in combined trading volume: Edel’s two index-linked tokens have reached $1 million in combined trading volume in less than a week. More assets, more venues and EDEL staking are next on the roadmap. Read more.

Edel passes $2 million in stock-token trading as staking plans take shape: Combined trading volume in SPYe and QQQe has passed $2 million, two days after reaching $1 million. Edel plans to reveal its staking tiers and participation details next week. Read more.

Greywick plans Litecoin on Canton with cLTC: Greywick Digital and the Litecoin Foundation have signed a memorandum of understanding supporting cLTC on Canton. A launch is targeted for the end of 2026, subject to publishing reserve and rollout details. Read more.

CanTra seeks Canton Featured App status for art-linked securities: CanTra has applied for Featured App status on Canton ahead of an offering linked to a Francis Bacon triptych. The planned investment starts at €100, subject to investor eligibility and the offering terms. Read more.
